tabs.Характеристики: A low-pH gel for daily face cleansing. It helps wash away everyday impurities and excess sebum, leaving skin feeling clean and fresh. The formula contains gentle cleansing agents and betaine salicylate. Use it morning and evening; if your skin is sensitive, start with occasional use and watch how it reacts. The gel lathers easily and rinses off completely, leaving skin clean without that squeaky, tight feeling. It is one of the best-known cleansers in Korean skincare and a frequent pick for oily and combination skin.
tabs.Состав: Contains gentle cleansing agents, betaine salicylate and tea tree oil. The brand also lists hydrating ingredients and plant extracts, including yeast ferment extract.
tabs.Применение: Wet your face and hands. Squeeze a small amount of gel into your palms, add water and work into a lather. Gently massage over skin, avoiding the eye area, then rinse thoroughly. Use in the morning and/or evening. If your skin is sensitive or new to exfoliating ingredients, start with a few times a week.

tabs.Характеристики: A balm for the first cleansing step. It helps dissolve makeup, including long-wear face and eye products, and removes sunscreen residue and other oil-based impurities. The texture melts as you massage it in and emulsifies when water is added. The brand describes Original as suitable for different skin types. The firm balm comes in a jar with a spatula and melts into an oil on contact with skin. A small scoop is enough for the whole face, and it rinses off without a greasy film. Easy to travel with, since a jar won’t leak like a bottle of oil.
tabs.Состав: The formula also contains hot spring water, plant extracts, vitamin E and fragrance. Botanicals include bamboo, rooibos, angelica and acerola extracts.
tabs.Применение: With clean, dry hands, scoop a little balm with the spatula and apply to dry skin. Massage gently in circles to dissolve makeup and impurities. Add a little water and keep massaging until the balm turns into an emulsion. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. Follow with a foam or other second-step cleanser if needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle daily gel cleanser that creates a soft foam and helps remove everyday impurities. The brand positions it as comfortable cleansing with a skin-friendly pH. It works well as a basic cleansing step but isn’t designed to dissolve long-wear makeup the way a cleansing oil or balm does. The gel doesn’t over-dry, so it works for morning cleansing too. Green plum contains natural fruit acids that gently refresh skin, while mung bean extract softens it. A light fruity scent turns cleansing into a small ritual.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are green plum water and mung bean seed extract. The formula also contains cleansing and hydrating agents. The brand describes it as non-aggressive cleansing.
tabs.Применение: Wet your face and hands, lather a small amount between your palms and spread over skin with light circular motions. Rinse with warm water and pat dry with a towel without rubbing. In the evening, if you wear heavy makeup, pre-cleanse first.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing balm that helps dissolve makeup, sunscreen and sebum. It melts on dry skin and emulsifies and rinses off when water is added. This soft balm with mineral-rich sea water from Ulleungdo leaves no heavy feeling and works for everyday makeup removal. It sets skin up nicely for the second cleansing step with a foam or gel. Skin stays soft, never tight.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines cleansing oils and emulsifiers; the brand lists the enzyme protease and hydrating agents.
tabs.Применение: Apply the balm with dry hands to a dry face and massage gently, focusing on makeup and sunscreen. Add a little water until it turns milky, then rinse. Avoid harsh rubbing and contact with the eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: A foam that cleanses skin of everyday impurities and leftover skincare. It’s a rinse-off product and doesn’t replace an oil or balm first step when you wear long-wear makeup. It whips into a thick, soft lather, so there’s no rubbing while you cleanse. Hyaluronic acid helps hold on to moisture, so skin doesn’t feel dry after washing. A good fit for dehydrated and sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: The DIVE-IN line features several forms of hyaluronic acid along with hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: Wet your hands and face, lather a small amount and spread gently over skin. Rinse thoroughly and pat your face dry. If you feel dryness or tightness, use less product or cleanse less often, then follow with hydrating care.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing oil. It helps dissolve makeup, sunscreen and sebum; mixed with water it turns into an emulsion and rinses away. The oil is especially good for pores: regular use helps reduce blackheads and that gritty feel on the nose and chin. Heartleaf, Anua’s star ingredient, calms skin prone to redness. The lightweight texture won’t clog pores.
tabs.Состав: The formula has an oil base and emulsifiers plus heartleaf extract. The ingredient list includes plant oils and fragrance components.
tabs.Применение: Apply with dry hands to dry skin and massage to dissolve makeup and impurities. Wet your fingertips and keep massaging until the oil becomes a milky emulsion, then rinse thoroughly. Don’t apply to the eye mucosa; finish with a foam cleanser if needed.

somebymi-miracle-foam.description: Acid cleansing foam for blemish-prone skin

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off cleansing foam from the 30 Days Miracle line. It lathers up and helps remove impurities, and the formula includes ingredients the brand uses in care for breakout-prone skin. AHA, BHA and PHA gently exfoliate while you cleanse, and tea tree helps with breakouts. It suits oily and acne-prone skin; if your skin is dry, don’t use it every day. The brand promises visible results after 30 days of regular use.
tabs.Состав: Contains salicylic acid at 5,000 ppm (0.5%), tea tree water, centella extract and a small amount of a PHA ingredient.
tabs.Применение: Lather a small amount between wet palms, apply to your face with light movements and rinse thoroughly. Don’t use on broken skin and avoid the eye area. If you notice dryness, flaking or redness, use it less often or stop; during the day follow the brand’s sun-protection advice for AHA formulas.

purito-deep-sea-oil.description: Cleansing oil with olive and vitamin E

tabs.Характеристики: A cleansing oil for the first step of your evening routine. A blend of five plant oils gently dissolves makeup, sunscreen and excess sebum, and turns into a light milk on contact with water, rinsing off without a greasy film. Great for dry and normal skin that doesn’t like foam as a first step. It’s free of fragrance and essential oils, so sensitive skin can use it too. One or two pumps are enough to remove even waterproof mascara.
tabs.Состав: Based on olive oil with vitamin E, plus sunflower, jojoba, grapeseed and sweet almond oils. A short, no-frills formula: the oils soften skin and help remove long-wear makeup without rubbing.
tabs.Применение: Apply 2–3 pumps to a dry face with dry hands and massage in circles for 30–60 seconds. Add a little water so the oil turns milky, massage again and rinse with warm water. Then cleanse with a gentle foam.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing balm with a focus on pores. It melts on dry skin, dissolves makeup, sunscreen and excess sebum, then emulsifies with water and rinses off easily. Plant-based ingredients help clear pores without tightness, so it works for combination skin as well.

A daily cleansing foam from the Mung Bean line. The brand positions it as a pH-balanced cleanser that removes everyday impurities and leaves skin clean without a heavy film. Mung bean is a traditional Korean cleansing ingredient that cleans gently and calms skin. The foam is creamy, doesn’t dry skin out and is fine for daily use morning and evening. A good pick for sensitive and combination skin.
tabs.Состав: The line’s star ingredient is mung bean extract; surfactants do the cleansing, and the formula is topped up with hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: Wet your face and hands, lather a small amount and spread gently over skin. Rinse with plenty of water. If you feel persistent tightness or dryness after cleansing, use less product and cleanse less often.

tabs.Характеристики: Toner pads for quick care of skin prone to redness, oily shine and uneven texture. The soft side is for gentle wiping, the textured side for more thorough contact where you want to refresh the skin’s surface. You can also leave a pad on your face for a few minutes as a spot hydrating mask. The pads quickly soothe skin after sun exposure and cool down that hot, flushed feeling. They’re handy in the morning in place of toner and save time. Suitable for oily and sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines heartleaf extract, niacinamide, panthenol and allantoin. The brand also lists a fermented hydrating complex, succinic acid and caffeine.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, sweep a pad over your skin without pressing hard and avoiding the eye area. For spot care, place a pad on the area for a few minutes, then remove it and pat in the remaining essence. Adjust how often you use them to how your skin feels; stop if irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: A watery exfoliating toner for daily care of uneven texture and dull tone. It gently refreshes the skin’s surface after cleansing and preps it for the next steps. As an acid product, it doesn’t replace sunscreen and may not suit skin that tolerates exfoliants poorly. It refreshes skin and gently smooths texture without the sting of classic acid toners. Afterwards skin takes in serum and cream more easily. Use it a few evenings a week, and don’t forget SPF in the morning.
tabs.Состав: Based on green plum water and mung bean extract, with AHA and BHA ingredients for gentle renewal. The formula also contains hydrating and softening agents.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply a small amount with your palms or a cotton pad without rubbing. Start with occasional use and watch how your skin reacts, especially if your routine already includes acids or retinoids. Use sunscreen during the day; if you feel strong stinging, rinse it off and stop using it.

tabs.Характеристики: A refreshing toner for dull skin and uneven texture. The acid formula helps keep skin looking smoother, and the watery base is perfect after cleansing. The toner lightly exfoliates, helps reduce blackheads and preps skin for the next steps. It suits oily and combination skin, but if you’re new to acids, start with every other day. Always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply the toner to a cotton pad and gently sweep over your face, avoiding the eyes and lips; with sensitive skin, use your palms and start slowly. Don’t layer it with other strong acids or retinoids in the same routine unless your skin is used to that combination.

tabs.Характеристики: A light watery toner for skin that lacks moisture and comfort after cleansing. The formula targets multi-layer hydration and spreads quickly without a heavy creamy layer. You can layer it several times, the Korean “7 skin” way, for plump, fresh-looking skin. The texture is slightly viscous but absorbs fast without stickiness. Free of alcohol and fragrance, it suits even sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights 14 forms of hyaluronic acid with different molecular weights and sea water from Ulleungdo Island. It also contains hydrating ingredients that help relieve the feeling of dryness.
tabs.Применение: Pat the toner onto clean skin of the face and neck with your palms, spread gently and let it absorb. If your skin needs more hydration, apply another thin layer, then seal it with a serum or cream. Avoid contact with the eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: Toner pads for dull tone and post-acne marks. The textile pad helps spread the essence quickly over your skin or use it locally on areas that need extra hydration and care. Sold in sets and with refills. The pads work as a quick 5–10 minute mask on the cheeks or pigmented areas. They’re well soaked, with enough essence left over for the neck. With regular use, skin tone looks more even and brighter.
tabs.Состав: In the No.5 line the brand focuses on niacinamide, vitamin C, glutathione and tranexamic acid — ingredients for uneven tone — in a hydrating base.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, gently sweep a pad over your face without pulling the skin. For spot care, leave the pad on the chosen area for a short time, then remove it and pat in the remaining essence. Avoid the eyes and use SPF in your daytime routine, especially if you also use acids or vitamin C.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily liquid toner for hydration and a smoother skin feel after cleansing. The Dokdo line is based on mineral sea water, and the texture is designed for light application without a heavy film. Use it as the first watery step of a basic routine. The toner gently exfoliates and smooths skin without drying it out. It’s one of Round Lab’s bestsellers, loved for its versatility and a formula that suits almost everyone. Works well both morning and evening.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are sea water from Ulleungdo Island, humectants, panthenol, allantoin and betaine. The brand also lists a ferment ingredient for skin-surface care.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean skin with your palms or a cotton pad and spread gently. Let it absorb before serum and cream. If using a pad, don’t rub, and stop if persistent irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: Large soaked pads for refreshing, hydrating care of sensitive or tired skin. Use them for gentle wiping after cleansing or leave them on specific areas for a few minutes as a compress. A handy way to combine a toner and a spot-mask step. Carotene from carrots helps calm redness and gives skin a fresh look. The pads are especially nice in summer or after a long day — keep them in the fridge for an extra cooling effect. Suitable for sensitive and irritated skin.
tabs.Состав: The line’s key ingredients are carrot extract and carotene-rich carrot oil. The formula also includes a watery essence and humectants.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, place pads on the areas you want to treat for a few minutes or gently sweep them over your face. Remove them, pat in the remaining essence, then follow with cream. Don’t use on broken skin and avoid the eye area.

tabs.Характеристики: A richer-feeling toner that softens skin and adds moisture after cleansing. The brand describes it as multi-purpose: layer it, apply with a cotton pad or use it as a short toner compress. “Mochi” describes the texture: slightly bouncy like the rice cake, leaving skin soft and springy. Ceramides support the skin barrier, making it great for dry skin and seasonal changes. You can go straight to cream afterwards, skipping serum.
tabs.Состав: Highlights include ceramide NP, glycerin, panthenol, allantoin and sodium hyaluronate; the formula also contains plant extracts.
tabs.Применение: Pat the toner in with your palms after cleansing until absorbed. For richer care, apply several thin layers; alternatively, soak cotton pads and leave them on dry areas for about 10 minutes. Choose whichever method feels comfortable.

tabs.Характеристики: A light toner from the hydrating DIVE-IN line for skin that feels dry and tight. The watery texture spreads quickly and serves as the first layer of moisture after cleansing. Use it morning and evening, then follow with serum and cream. Free of alcohol, fragrance and dyes, it suits even very sensitive skin. Pat it in with your hands or use it on cotton pads as a quick compress.
tabs.Состав: The formula focuses on a complex of different hyaluronic acids, plus panthenol and allantoin. These ingredients help keep skin hydrated and comfortable.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, pour a little toner into your palms, spread over your face and neck and let it absorb. Repeat with a thin layer if needed, without rubbing. Finish with cream; it doesn’t replace sunscreen in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A gel serum for dull tone, uneven texture and visible pores. If your skin is sensitive, introduce it gradually. Propolis nourishes and calms, niacinamide evens out tone, and a gentle BHA helps keep pores clear. The honey-like texture is a little tacky at first but absorbs quickly. A good fit for dull, combination and oily skin; with regular use skin looks noticeably more radiant.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are propolis extract, niacinamide and betaine salicylate, plus humectants, sodium hyaluronate and plant extracts including centella. Keep the BHA ingredient in mind when combining it with other acid products.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, spread an appropriate amount of serum over your face. Let it absorb, then apply cream; in the morning finish with sunscreen. Patch-test before first use, especially if your skin is sensitive to bee products or acids.

torriden-dive-in-serum.description: Serum with five types of hyaluronic acid

tabs.Характеристики: A light serum for skin that lacks moisture or comfort. The watery texture spreads quickly and is designed as a daily hydrating layer that never feels heavy. Use it morning and evening before cream. It’s one of Korea’s most popular hydrating serums: it suits almost every skin type and pairs well with any active ingredients. Free of fragrance, alcohol and dyes.
tabs.Состав: The key complex is five forms of hyaluronic acid with different molecular weights. The brand also highlights panthenol and allantoin for softening, soothing care.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a few drops to your face and pat gently until absorbed. Then seal with cream. The brand also suggests applying it under DIVE-IN pads for a short time as an intensive hydrating compress.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for hydrating care and a more radiant-looking complexion. In the PDRN Glow line the brand focuses on supporting firmness and smoothness; the airless pump helps dispense just the right amount. Designed for daily use morning and evening as directed by the brand. PDRN is one of the biggest trends in Korean skincare, helping skin recover and look fresher. The lightweight texture leaves a soft glow without greasy shine.
tabs.Состав: Contains Sodium DNA (PDRN), niacinamide, panthenol, beta-glucan and sodium hyaluronate, complemented by hydrolyzed collagen and six peptide ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, pump and spread over your face and neck. Let the serum absorb, then apply moisturizer. Store away from extreme temperatures and direct sunlight, as the brand recommends.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum from the No.3 line for uneven texture and dull-looking skin. It aims to make the skin’s surface look smoother and adds a hydrating step to your daily routine. Fermented ingredients and gentle exfoliants make skin feel smoother and pores look less visible. Use it before cream morning and evening. A great fit for dull skin with uneven texture.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount to your face, spread and pat gently until absorbed. Then use cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A soothing serum with Korean centella for sensitive, irritated and dehydrated skin. The light gel texture absorbs quickly, relieves tightness and helps skin look calmer and more even. The formula is free of fragrance and essential oils, so it’s easy to use even on very sensitive skin or after treatments. It pairs well with acids and retinol and helps soften their effect.
tabs.Состав: Centella asiatica extract and its four active compounds — madecassoside, asiaticoside, madecassic and asiatic acids — plus niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate, panthenol, allantoin, peptides and ceramide NP to hydrate and support the skin barrier.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and neck and pat in lightly. Wait until the serum absorbs, then move on to cream. Suitable for morning and evening routines.

tabs.Характеристики: A light serum from the peach line for hydration and care of dull, uneven tone. The texture is watery, so it fits easily into a morning or evening routine. Peach extract makes up 70% of the formula, adding freshness and softness, while niacinamide and alpha-arbutin help even out tone. With regular use, skin looks brighter and more radiant. It has a light, pleasant peach scent.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are peach extract, 5% niacinamide, fermented ingredients, sodium hyaluronate and alpha-arbutin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a few drops to your face and neck after cleansing and toner, avoiding the eye area, then pat gently until absorbed. The brand allows use up to twice a day. In the morning, apply sunscreen after the serum.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for redness and uneven texture. Introduce it gradually, especially if you use acids or retinoids. Azelaic acid gently addresses redness, post-acne marks and uneven texture, while hyaluronic acid and panthenol keep skin from drying out. A good choice for sensitive and rosacea-prone skin. The light gel texture absorbs quickly.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are azelaic acid, a hyaluronic acid complex, panthenol and centella with its derivatives, providing active and hydrating care.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount to your face, avoiding the eye area. Start with occasional use and don’t combine it in one evening with several strong exfoliants unless your skin is used to them. Stop if persistent stinging or irritation occurs; wear SPF during the day.

tabs.Состав: The brand also lists arbutin, including alpha-arbutin, humectants and hyaluronic acid derivatives.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a few drops to your face, spread gently and let it absorb, then use cream. If your skin is reactive, start with a small area and limited frequency. Use SPF in your daytime routine.
tabs.Характеристики: A serum for pigmentation, post-acne marks and dull tone. Niacinamide 10% and tranexamic acid 4% work as a pair to even out skin tone and fade dark spots. The light texture absorbs quickly and works morning and evening — always follow with SPF during the day.

A hydrating serum with capsules in the texture to keep skin soft and looking plumper. Part of the PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 line. Tiny capsules burst as you apply the serum and spread evenly over the skin. PDRN helps skin recover, while hyaluronic acid delivers deep hydration. Skin looks plump, smooth and radiant.
tabs.Состав: The formula is built on salmon-DNA-derived PDRN and a hyaluronic acid complex, plus hydrating ingredients and collagen.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply the serum to your face and spread gently, then use cream. If you can see capsules in the texture, spread them evenly over your skin until absorbed.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum with a vitamin complex for dull skin tone and post-acne marks. The formula combines four forms of vitamin C that complement each other — some act faster, others are gentler and more stable. Glutathione and vitamin E boost antioxidant protection and help skin look brighter. The light texture works well in the morning under SPF.
tabs.Состав: The formula contains 5% ascorbic acid, 2% sodium ascorbyl phosphate, 2% ethyl ascorbyl ether and 1.05% ascorbyl glucoside, plus glutathione, tocopherol and other antioxidants. It also contains alcohol and essential oils, including citrus and lavender — worth noting for sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean skin and spread gently until absorbed. Start with a few times a week to see how your skin tolerates this rich vitamin formula. Always finish your morning routine with SPF; avoid contact with the eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing ampoule for hydrating care and softer, more radiant-looking skin. The brand describes the texture as light for such a rich formula; apply after cleansing and toner. Propolis, honey and royal jelly nourish skin and help it recover, making the ampoule especially good for dry, tired skin. The texture is honey-like but not sticky, leaving skin looking rested and glowing. A great rescue product for the cold season.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights red propolis and a complex of bee products, including honey and royal jelly.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, spread the ampoule over your face and pat gently until absorbed. The brand allows morning and evening use. During the day, finish with sunscreen.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum with a high concentration of pure vitamin C for dull tone, dark spots and early signs of photoaging. The formula is meant for people already familiar with vitamin C; sensitive skin should start especially slowly. The serum is water-free, which keeps pure vitamin C stable for longer and slows oxidation. Apply it in the evening, or in the morning under SPF, on dry skin, starting a couple of times a week. A slight tingle in the first days is normal at this concentration.
tabs.Состав: The main active is 23% pure ascorbic acid, complemented by vitamin E and glutathione; key ingredients also include niacinamide, panthenol and hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face, spread gently, then use cream. If using in the daytime, always apply SPF. The brand advises against combining it in the same routine with copper peptides and strong actives like retinol; separate them by time of day or by day.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for uneven tone and visible post-acne marks. Apply the light formula all over or locally to areas with unwanted pigmentation. Alpha-arbutin is a gentle ingredient for pigmentation: it suits even sensitive skin and doesn’t cause peeling like acids. Tranexamic acid and niacinamide boost the effect for a more even tone. Wear SPF during the day so spots don’t come back.
tabs.Состав: The key active is 2% alpha-arbutin, combined with tranexamic acid, niacinamide and N-acetylglucosamine. Supporting ingredients include ferulic acid, glutathione, panthenol and several forms of hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply the serum evenly and let it absorb. The brand allows layering two or three thin coats if needed. Use SPF in the morning, especially if your routine includes other tone-evening actives.

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating essence that softens skin and keeps it comfortable. The texture is slightly stretchy but spreads in a thin layer; use it before cream. Snail mucin is a Korean skincare legend: it hydrates, helps skin recover after breakouts and leaves it soft and smooth. The essence is loved for its versatility — it suits almost any skin type and pairs well with actives. Skin looks healthy with a subtle glow.
tabs.Состав: Contains 96.3% snail secretion filtrate, betaine and sodium hyaluronate, plus allantoin and panthenol. Not vegan because of the snail-derived ingredient.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount to your face and pat gently until absorbed. Then use a moisturizer. Avoid it if you’re allergic to snail-derived ingredients.

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for hydrating, soothing care focused on uneven tone and post-acne marks. Red onion extract helps fade post-acne marks and small scars, while vitamin B5 (panthenol) soothes and repairs. The ampoule suits sensitive skin recovering from breakouts. The light texture absorbs quickly.
tabs.Состав: The Onion Newpair line uses red onion extract. The ampoule also contains hydrating and soothing ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply an appropriate amount to your face, spread and pat gently until absorbed. Then apply cream. Start with your usual routine frequency and reduce it if you feel discomfort.

numbuzin-no5-glutathione.description: Glutathione serum for an even tone

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for dull tone and visible dark marks. The formula combines antioxidant and tone-evening ingredients; the brand also emphasizes hydration and barrier support. Glutathione is a powerful antioxidant that helps skin look brighter, while the vitamin complex evens out tone and adds radiance. Apply it morning and evening all over or just on dark spots. With regular use, skin looks more even and rested.
tabs.Применение: Apply the serum after cleansing and toner, spread evenly and let it absorb. Then use cream; in the daytime, add sunscreen. If your skin is sensitive, patch-test first.

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for a hydrating, tone-evening layer. You can see capsules in the formula; it’s designed for dull-looking skin and uneven tone while keeping soothing centella at its core. Capsules with brightening ingredients burst as you apply it, while Madagascar centella calms the skin, so the ampoule suits even sensitive types. With regular use, tone looks more even and skin fresher. The light texture won’t weigh down makeup.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply the ampoule to your face, spreading the visible capsules evenly until absorbed. Then apply cream. In the daytime, finish with SPF; introduce gradually if your skin is sensitive.

tabs.Характеристики: A light watery ampoule for hydrating, soothing care. The brand positions it as a versatile product that helps skin look more comfortable and balanced. The texture spreads quickly and never feels heavy. The ampoule is made of 100% Madagascar centella extract — no water, fragrance or alcohol. It quickly calms redness and irritation, which is why sensitive and acne-prone skin loves it. It’s one of SKIN1004’s most popular products.
tabs.Применение: Drop an appropriate amount onto your face after cleansing and toner, or wherever it fits in your routine. Spread evenly and pat gently until absorbed, then apply cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A pure vitamin C serum for a more even, radiant-looking complexion. The brand describes it as a rich formula for dullness, dark spots and early signs of aging. Because of the high concentration, introduce it gradually, especially if your skin isn’t used to vitamin C. Centella and bisabolol soften the effect of high-strength vitamin C, while peptides and collagen support firmness. With regular use, skin looks more radiant and dark spots lighter. Always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: The main active is 24% ascorbic acid. The formula also lists betaine, bisabolol and centella complex ingredients, plus peptides and collagen ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and spread gently, then use cream. The brand recommends using it no more than once a day, preferably in the evening. If you apply it in the morning, finish with SPF; stop if you notice marked irritation.

manyo-bifida-ampoule.description: Bifida ampoule for the skin barrier

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for hydrating care that keeps skin looking comfortable. The line is based on fermented ingredients; apply a light layer after toner and before cream. Bifida and lacto ferments support the skin microbiome — its natural defence — making skin more resilient and less reactive. The ampoule helps keep skin plump and hydrated. A good fit for dull, dry and tired skin.
tabs.Применение: After toner, apply a generous amount along the contours of your face and pat gently with your fingertips until absorbed. Then finish with cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A capsule serum for dull tone and visibly uneven texture. The formula combines bright active ingredients with a softening base; if your skin is sensitive, introduce it carefully and don’t start several new actives at once. Kojic acid, turmeric and niacinamide work together to fade dark spots and post-acne marks. Capsules with actives burst as you apply it, while squalane and panthenol keep skin from drying out. Always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: The formula also includes allantoin, panthenol, squalane and glycolic acid, and contains cypress wood essential oil.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face after toner, spread evenly and finish with cream. When starting out, use it less often and don’t combine it in one evening with strong acids or retinoids until you know how your skin tolerates it. Use SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for post-acne marks, uneven tone and dullness. The light texture absorbs quickly, doesn’t weigh skin down and suits even oily skin. With regular use, skin looks more even and glows from within. The formula is gentle enough for daily use morning and evening, even on sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: 5% niacinamide evens out tone and makes pores less visible. Rice bran, papaya and sea buckthorn extracts add radiance and antioxidant protection. Plant-derived squalane hydrates without greasiness, and allantoin soothes.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount all over or directly onto spots and spread until absorbed. Then apply cream, and always wear SPF during the day.
Apply a small amount after cleansing and toner, spread evenly and finish with cream. If using in the morning, apply SPF.
tabs.Характеристики: A vitamin C booster for dull skin, uneven tone and post-acne marks. The concentrated formula helps bring back radiance and fade spots, while hydrating ingredients soften the vitamin’s effect. The small bottle is handy for a course of use; always wear SPF during the day.

A retinal booster for skin firmness, fine lines and enlarged pores. Retinal works faster than classic retinol, while peptides and panthenol keep the care gentle. The small size is designed for an evening course. Start with 1–2 times a week and increase gradually, and always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: 0.1% liposomal retinal penetrates deeper and irritates less. A 3% Matrixyl peptide complex supports firmness, and 1% panthenol soothes and hydrates. The formula also contains niacinamide.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount in the evening to clean, dry skin. For the first two weeks use it every other night, then nightly once your skin adjusts. If redness appears, use less, less often, and add a soothing cream. Always apply SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing cream for dry, sensitive skin and a weakened barrier. The current version contains capsules with lipid ingredients for long-lasting hydration — the brand claims up to 120 hours. Available in several sizes. AESTURA is a Korean pharmacy brand that develops skincare together with dermatologists. This cream is their bestseller for very dry skin and seasonal changes.
tabs.Состав: Contains ceramide NP, cholesterol, phytosphingosine and fatty acids, plus niacinamide and allantoin. The brand describes the system as high-density ceramide capsules.
tabs.Применение: At the end of your routine, apply an appropriate amount to your face and spread gently until absorbed. Use morning and evening, adjusting the amount to how your skin feels. If the texture feels heavy, apply a thinner layer.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich cream for the final step of your routine when skin needs hydration and barrier support. Designed for morning and evening use; the soft creamy texture helps relieve dryness and makes skin look more elastic. The tube makes it easy to dispense and travel with. PDRN and peptides help skin recover and look firmer, while ceramides and squalane protect against dryness. Great for evening routines and the cold season.
tabs.Состав: The brand lists 1.5% PDRN derived from salmon DNA, along with niacinamide, ceramide NP, panthenol, squalane, hyaluronic acid and several peptides.
tabs.Применение: Apply the cream after serum as the last step and spread evenly over your face. The brand allows morning and evening use. During the day, finish with sun protection.

tabs.Характеристики: A light moisturizing cream for skin that needs a calmer, more comfortable finish to the routine. The brand describes the texture as non-greasy and emphasizes support for the moisture barrier. Use it after serum or ampoule, morning and evening. Heartleaf calms redness and ceramides help lock in moisture, making it great for sensitive and combination skin. The light texture won’t clog pores and sits well under makeup.
tabs.Состав: The formula features 70% heartleaf extract, panthenol and ceramide NP, plus cholesterol and hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After serum, apply the cream to your face and neck with your fingers or a clean spatula. Use morning and evening; in the morning, top with sunscreen. When skin feels dry, you can apply several thin layers if that’s comfortable.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream from the PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 line. The brand promises long-lasting moisture retention and a comfortable texture for the final step of your routine. PDRN helps skin recover, while hyaluronic acid and collagen leave it plump and bouncy. Squalane and niacinamide soften skin and even out tone. Works best paired with the serum from the same line.
tabs.Состав: Contains Sodium DNA (PDRN), hydrolyzed collagen, squalane, niacinamide and a complex of several forms of hyaluronic acid, plus centella and its derivatives.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount after serum, spread over your face and neck and gently tap in with your fingertips. Use as the last step morning or evening. Add SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A light cream for daily hydration and softer-looking skin. The brand describes the texture as non-sticky; it finishes your routine nicely and can be layered thinly in the cold season. According to the brand, the pink tint comes from vitamin B12, not an artificial dye. Niacinamide evens out tone and adds glow, while ceramides support the skin barrier. A delicate peach scent makes it a pleasure to apply.
tabs.Состав: Based on 77% peach fruit water, with niacinamide, panthenol, ceramide NP and fermented ingredients. The brand lists collagen and pectin as part of the hydrating complex. Contains fragrance — worth noting for sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: After ampoule or serum, spread the cream over your face and neck and pat gently until absorbed. Use morning and evening. During the day, finish with sunscreen; when skin is dry, apply several thin layers.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream for softer, more radiant-looking skin. Apply after toner and serum, morning and evening. For oily or breakout-prone skin, the brand recommends using less than for dry skin. It’s inspired by royal skincare recipes of Korea’s Joseon dynasty: rice bran and ginseng nourish skin and give it a soft glow. The texture is rich but melts in and leaves no greasy shine.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are rice bran water, ginseng root water, squalane and niacinamide, plus ceramide NP, honey and several forms of hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, toner and serum, apply a small amount to your face and neck and pat gently until absorbed. Morning and evening, adjust the amount to how your skin feels. During the day, finish with SPF.

boj-red-bean-gel.description: Light gel cream for oily skin

tabs.Характеристики: A light gel cream that hydrates skin that doesn’t like heavy or greasy coverage. The brand positions it mainly for oily and breakout-prone skin; it keeps skin comfortable without a heavy layer. Use it morning and evening as the final hydrating step. Red bean helps control oily shine and makes pores look smaller. The gel sits nicely under makeup.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are red bean extract and a peptide complex. The formula also contains panthenol, allantoin, betaine and hydrating agents.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face after serum and spread with light strokes. Suitable for day and night; if needed, layer a richer cream on dry areas. Apply SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A night cream with retinal and bakuchiol for uneven texture and early signs of aging. Introduce it gradually, especially if your skin hasn’t used retinoids before. The brand recommends evening use. Bakuchiol is a plant-based alternative to retinol and gentler on skin, so this cream is a good first step into retinoids.
tabs.Состав: The brand states 0.03% retinal and 1% bakuchiol, plus niacinamide, humectants and emollients including ceramide NP. According to the brand, the yellowish tint comes from retinal, not an artificial dye.
tabs.Применение: Apply in the evening after serum, starting with one or two times a week and a small amount. If your skin tolerates it well, gradually increase the frequency. Use SPF during the day; the brand advises against using it during pregnancy and breastfeeding and against combining it with vitamin C or exfoliants in the same routine.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing face cream that helps relieve dryness and support the skin barrier. Ideal as the final step; the texture applies comfortably without a complicated multi-step routine. Ceramides, cholesterol and fatty acids are the same lipids that make up the skin barrier, so the cream helps skin recover after over-drying or actives. Suitable for dry, sensitive and dehydrated skin. Fragrance-free.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights ceramides, cholesterol, fatty acids, panthenol and several forms of hyaluronic acid. These help soften skin and lock in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Spread a small amount over your face after toner and serum. Use morning and/or evening; finish with sunscreen during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich cream for daily care of skin that lacks hydration and firmness. Formulas in this line combine centella derivatives (TECA) with hydrating ingredients. TECA is a concentrate of centella’s active compounds that helps skin recover and stay firm. The cream suits mature and dry skin, as well as skin weakened by treatments. Best used in the evening when skin needs rich care.

A light cream for daily care that the brand positions for skin prone to redness and blemishes. It hydrates and completes a basic routine; apply it locally or more widely, depending on what your skin needs. The cream is light, absorbs quickly and suits oily and combination skin with redness. It’s loved for being gentle yet noticeably calming on breakouts. Sits well under makeup.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step in a thin layer over your face or on areas that need extra hydration.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream for daily facial hydration, made for skin that lacks softness and comfort. Hyaluronic acid and ceramides hold moisture and strengthen the skin barrier, so skin stays soft for hours. It suits dry and sensitive skin, and the light texture leaves no stickiness. ILLIYOON is a Korean brand known for gentle formulas for the whole family.
tabs.Применение: Apply an appropriate amount to your face after watery products and serum. Use morning and evening or as needed; top with SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream from the Water Bank line for hydration and skin barrier support. The brand promises a soft creamy texture and care for dry or dull skin. Laneige’s Blue Hyaluronic Acid hydrates on several levels, so moisture lasts for hours. The cream suits normal and dry skin, leaving it plump and glowing.
tabs.Применение: Apply evenly to your face after cleansing, toner and serum, morning and/or evening. In your daytime routine, finish with sun protection.
Apply a small amount to your face and neck after serum and spread gently until absorbed. Use morning or evening, avoiding the eyes.
tabs.Характеристики: A lifting cream with nine peptides for firmer skin and a more defined facial contour. Peptides help skin look denser and smooth fine lines, and the rich texture nourishes — ideal for the evening. Works well with the matching Peptide 9 serum.

A daily cream with birch sap that hydrates skin and keeps it comfortable. The brand also makes a richer Birch Moisturizing Intensive Cream. Birch sap is rich in minerals and gives skin light, fresh hydration. The cream suits normal and combination skin and layers well under makeup and sunscreen. In summer it works as your main moisturizer.
tabs.Применение: Apply to your face after toner and serum and spread until absorbed. Use morning and/or evening; apply sunscreen in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A centella cream for hydrating care and a comfortable skin feel. SKIN1004 has several Madagascar Centella products and cream formulas. Madagascar centella calms redness and helps skin recover, while the light cream absorbs quickly with no stickiness. It suits sensitive and combination skin. Use it in the morning under SPF or in the evening.
tabs.Применение: Apply the cream to your face as the last step after toner and serum. Start with a small amount, especially if the product is new to your skin.
Apply a small amount of cream to your face and neck after serum. Use as the final step, morning or evening.
tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream with olive-derived squalane for dry and dehydrated skin. Squalane is similar to skin’s own lipids, so it absorbs fast, softens and helps hold moisture without a greasy film. The light texture works morning and evening and suits sensitive skin too.

A cream from the BALANCEFUL line, designed for sensitive, irritation-prone skin. It rounds out your hydrating routine. Centella calms redness, while barrier-supporting ingredients help skin become less reactive. The light gel-cream texture suits combination skin too. Fragrance-free.
tabs.Состав: The BALANCEFUL line is built around a soothing Cica complex and barrier-supporting ingredients.
tabs.Применение: Apply after toner and serum all over your face or on areas that need extra comfort. Use morning and/or evening.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily moisturizing cream from the DIVE-IN line. The brand links the line to low-molecular hyaluronic acid and maintaining the skin’s water balance. The light gel-cream absorbs quickly with no stickiness, so it suits even oily skin that lacks moisture. It’s easy to use in the morning under SPF and makeup. Free of fragrance and alcohol.
tabs.Состав: The line’s key ingredient is a hyaluronic acid complex; the formula also uses hydrating and softening agents.
tabs.Применение: Spread a small amount over your face after cleansing, toner and serum. Use morning and evening; top with SPF in the morning.

Apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin, avoiding the eyes and lips. Start with occasional use and don’t combine it in one evening with acids, retinoids or other irritating products. If you feel strong stinging, rinse off and stop using it.
tabs.Характеристики: A lifting cream with nano spicules — tiny natural sponge needles that gently renew the skin surface and help actives work better. A light tingle after applying is normal. It helps skin look smoother and firmer; start with a couple of times a week and avoid irritated skin.

A cream from WELLAGE’s hydrating line, designed for everyday use and a comfortable skin feel. Wellage is known in Korea for its hyaluronic acid, which holds moisture and leaves skin soft and plump. The cream suits dry and sensitive skin and relieves tightness. The light texture sits well under makeup.
tabs.Применение: Apply an appropriate amount at the end of your routine, spreading gently over your face. Use morning and/or evening; finish with SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream for dry and sensitive skin that the brand credits with long-lasting hydration. The fragrance-free formula is made for daily use as the final step. Five types of ceramides mirror the skin barrier, so the cream helps restore it after over-drying or actives. Skin stays soft for hours without flaking.
tabs.Состав: Contains panthenol, sodium hyaluronate, cholesterol and five ceramides — NP, NS, AS, AP and EOP — plus allantoin and emollients.
tabs.Применение: After serum, apply an appropriate amount to your face and spread gently until absorbed. Use morning and evening, or apply a thinner layer by day and a richer one at night if that suits your skin. Finish your morning routine with SPF.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream from the Bifida Biome line for the final step of your routine. The brand also makes the Bifida Biome Aqua Barrier Cream and an eye cream — these are separate products. Bifida ferments support the skin microbiome and make skin more resilient, while the nourishing texture helps smooth fine dryness lines. Great for dry and mature skin and for colder months. Pairs well with the Bifida ampoule from the same line.
tabs.Состав: The key ingredient in the Bifida Biome line is the Bifida ferment complex.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face after serum as the final cream step. Use morning or evening; with sensitive skin, introduce new products gradually.

tabs.Характеристики: A light gel cream with a jelly texture for facial hydration. The feel and finish depend on how much you apply and the condition of your skin. Collagen in a jelly texture gives skin bounce and a fresh glow, and the cream absorbs fast without stickiness. It suits normal and combination skin and sits nicely under makeup. People love the cooling feel as you apply it.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face as the last step and spread evenly. Use a thin layer in the morning under SPF or a more generous layer at night.

tabs.Характеристики: This is sun protection, not a regular moisturizer — apply it as the last step of your morning routine. The silky texture spreads easily, leaves no white cast and doesn’t pill under makeup. Heartleaf calms skin, making it suitable for sensitive types. Reapply every 2–3 hours if you’re out in the sun for a long time.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines UV filters and hydrating ingredients; heartleaf is the key botanical in the Heartleaf line.
tabs.Применение: Apply a generous amount evenly to your face as the final step of your morning routine before going out in the sun. Don’t rely on a thin layer of regular cream as a substitute for SPF.

tabs.Характеристики: A tinted sunscreen for your daytime routine, not a regular face cream. The peachy tint lightly evens out skin tone and gives a fresh, rested look — you can wear it instead of a makeup primer. Niacinamide helps even out tone over time. Suitable for normal and combination skin.
tabs.Состав: Contains titanium dioxide, fragrance and color pigments that create the Melting Peach tone-up effect.
tabs.Применение: Apply evenly as the last step of your morning routine before going out in the sun.

tabs.Характеристики: A two-piece hydrogel face mask designed for long wear. As you wear it, the material becomes more transparent; the brand recommends waiting for this change before finishing. It’s a hydrating mask, not a rinse-off clay mask. It’s easy to wear overnight: over several hours collagen and hydrating ingredients have time to soak in, and in the morning skin looks plump and glowing. This viral hit is what made Biodance famous.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and basic skincare, peel off the protective films and apply both pieces to your face. Leave on until transparent; the brand also describes extended use as an overnight mask. Remove if irritation occurs.

tabs.Характеристики: A two-step treatment: an ampoule serum and a cooling mask that helps hold it on the skin. The Moisturizing version is for hydrating care; the treatment takes about 20 minutes according to the brand’s instructions. The rubber mask has a cooling effect and stops the ampoule from evaporating, so skin gets maximum hydration. Perfect before a big event or after a flight — skin looks fresh and rested.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights hyaluronic acid and peptides in the ampoule; the mask itself creates a cooling layer.
tabs.Применение: Apply the ampoule to clean, dry skin. Then place the cooling mask on top, smooth it out and leave for about 20 minutes. Remove and pat in the remaining product; don’t reuse.

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating sheet mask with pearl extract for dull, dry skin. Pearl gives skin a soft glow, while marine ingredients and hyaluronic acid help drench it in moisture. The thin sheet fits snugly; leave it on for 15–20 minutes and pat in the leftover essence.

tabs.Применение: Unfold the mask, apply it to your cleansed face and smooth it out. Avoid contact with the eyes.
tabs.Характеристики: A hydrogel mask with black pearl and gold for radiant, firm-looking skin. The hydrogel clings closely and doesn’t dry out, so the hydrating ingredients work well in 20–30 minutes. Afterwards skin looks fresh, smooth and lifted.

tabs.Применение: Apply the mask to cleansed skin, smooth it gently and leave for the time stated on the sachet. Remove and pat in the remaining essence; if you feel discomfort, finish earlier.
tabs.Характеристики: Hydrogel masks with gold and royal jelly for nourished, glowing skin. Royal jelly helps soften dry, tired skin, while gold gives a fresh, rested look. The hydrogel clings closely and doesn’t dry out, so the hydration lasts.

Usually comes in two pieces that you can fit to the contours of your face. Single use. A mask with ruby powder and Bulgarian rose for fresh, radiant skin. Rose gently tones and hydrates, while the hydrogel clings closely and doesn’t dry out. Great for dull, tired skin — for example before a night out.
tabs.Состав: Published ingredient lists include damask rose water, ruby powder and plant extracts, including green tea and heartleaf.

tabs.Характеристики: A cooling hydrogel mask with a snug fit. The brand describes several types of collagen and recommends wearing it for 30 minutes to 2 hours, until the material becomes transparent. Collagen helps skin look firm and plump, and the hydrogel feels pleasantly cool. Easy to wear while you do chores or overnight.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, peel off the protective film, place the mask on your face and leave for 30 minutes to 2 hours until transparent. Remove and pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off cream-clay mask for areas that feel oily and congested pores. It has a bean base and clay; unlike a sheet mask, you use it for a short time and rinse it off. Use it 1–2 times a week on the T-zone or all over: it clears pores without over-drying. Red bean is a traditional Korean cleansing ingredient that gently purifies and refreshes.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are red bean extract and kaolin. The clay helps absorb excess sebum, and the plant base complements the cleansing care.
tabs.Применение: Apply an even layer to clean, dry skin, avoiding the eye and lip area. Leave for about 5–10 minutes, then rinse with warm water without rubbing. Use occasionally, not instead of your daily cleanser.

cosrx-pdrn-overnight-mask.description: PDRN peel-off mask for glass skin

tabs.Характеристики: A peel-off mask for a “glass skin” effect: it comes off in one layer and leaves your face smooth, bouncy and glossy. Great for dull skin with uneven texture. Comes with a silicone spatula. Great before a big event: the smooth, glowing effect shows right after you peel it off. Use it 1–2 times a week on clean skin and follow with cream.
tabs.Состав: PDRN supports firmness and radiance, while exosomes from lactobacilli and centella help deliver nutrients. Niacinamide evens out tone, hyaluronic acid and glycerin hydrate, and panthenol and allantoin soothe. The formula also contains hydrolyzed collagen and peptides.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply an even layer with the spatula, avoiding the eyes, brows and lips. Wait 15–20 minutes until it dries into a clear film, then gently peel it off from the edges toward the center. Pat in any residue. For a deeper effect, leave it on overnight and peel off in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A collagen peel-off day mask for glow and an even tone. The creamy texture glides on, sets into an elastic film in 20 minutes and peels off in one piece, no rinsing needed. Skin looks hydrated, a little firmer and radiant, without stickiness. It’s great in the morning before makeup — foundation goes on more evenly and skin looks fresh all day. Use it 2–3 times a week and follow with cream.
tabs.Состав: The Triple Glow complex combines collagen, glutathione, niacinamide and milk protein to hydrate and even out tone. Ultra-low-molecular collagen (130 Da) penetrates the skin more easily.
tabs.Применение: After toner and a light cream, apply an even layer, avoiding the eyes and lips. Wait about 20 minutes until it dries, then peel off the film. Rinse off any residue or simply pat it into your skin.

tabs.Характеристики: An overnight peel-off mask with collagen for firm, glowing skin. Apply a thin layer before bed; it sets into a flexible film that you peel off in one piece in the morning, no rinsing needed. Collagen and hydrating ingredients work all night, so in the morning skin looks smooth, plump and lifted.

tabs.Применение: Don’t apply near the eyes; rinse off if irritation occurs. Because of retinol and acid-like actives, don’t automatically combine it with other intensive products on the same night.
tabs.Характеристики: A peel-off mask with kojic acid and turmeric for an even, radiant tone. Kojic acid and turmeric help fade dark spots and post-acne marks, while the film keeps the actives on your skin. It sets and peels off in one piece, no rinsing; use it 1–2 times a week and wear SPF during the day.

medicube-pdrn-caffeine-mask.description: PDRN and caffeine overnight peel-off mask

tabs.Характеристики: A peel-off mask with PDRN and caffeine for fresh, lifted-looking skin. PDRN helps skin recover and caffeine wakes it up and reduces puffiness — a good pick after a short night. It sets into a flexible film and peels off in one piece, no rinsing.

A soothing sheet mask with a mildly acidic pH close to the skin’s natural pH. It helps relieve redness and irritation and supports the skin barrier. Suitable for sensitive and breakout-prone skin. The thin sheet fits snugly, with enough essence left for your neck. Keep it in the fridge for an extra calming effect on redness after sun or treatments.
tabs.Состав: The essence is almost 90% heartleaf extract, which soothes and calms redness. It’s complemented by centella and its active compounds, green tea, licorice and purslane extracts, allantoin and caffeine.
tabs.Применение: Remove the protective film and place the mask on a clean face. Leave for 15–20 minutes, then remove. Pat the remaining essence into your skin — no need to rinse. Finish with cream.
Place the mask on cleansed skin, lining up the openings with your eyes and mouth. Leave for the time stated on the sachet, then remove and pat in the remaining essence.
tabs.Характеристики: A soothing sheet mask with 77% heartleaf extract for sensitive, irritated skin. Heartleaf calms redness and helps skin recover faster, so the mask is perfect after sun, treatments or breakouts. The thin sheet fits snugly, and afterwards skin looks calm and fresh.

tabs.Состав: The brand highlights soothing and hydrating ingredients in the formula and positioning.
tabs.Характеристики: A centella sheet mask to calm skin and support its barrier. Centella soothes redness and irritation, while hydrating ingredients help skin feel comfortable again quickly. It suits sensitive skin and works well after sun or active treatments.

A sheet mask with PDRN and rose extract for a healthy glow and smooth skin. It hydrates, soothes and helps pores look less visible. Great for dull, tired skin. Perfect before going out — skin looks fresh and rested. Leave it on for 15–20 minutes and pat the leftover essence into your face and neck.
tabs.Состав: PDRN supports skin recovery, while damask rose and rose water hydrate and tone. A pore complex of chestnut and fig extracts, witch hazel and the PHA gluconolactone. Panthenol, squalane, argan oil and ceramide NP soften and protect the skin.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face and smooth it along the contours. Leave for 15–20 minutes, remove and pat the remaining essence into your skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A soothing tea tree sheet mask for problem skin. It helps relieve irritation, clear pores and control oily shine without drying skin out. Made from soft bamboo-fiber fabric. Mediheal is one of Korea’s best-known sheet mask brands. Use it 2–3 times a week during breakouts or after a hot day when skin gets oilier.
tabs.Состав: The Tea Tree Active 3x complex: tea tree leaf extract, water and oil plus terpineol, complemented by panthenol, allantoin, betaine, trehalose and amino acids that hydrate and soothe.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply the mask and smooth it around your eyes, nose and lips. Leave for 10–20 minutes, remove and pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Характеристики: An intensely hydrating sheet mask for dehydrated skin. It quickly restores comfort and freshness and suits both dry and oily skin that lacks moisture. It’s one of Mediheal’s top bestsellers — people keep it on hand for dry days and flights. Afterwards skin looks plump and glowing, and makeup goes on more smoothly.
tabs.Состав: Natural moisturizing factor (NMF) — amino acids that help skin hold on to water. Sodium hyaluronate and polyglutamic acid hydrate, witch hazel and rose water refresh, and purslane extract, aloe, panthenol and allantoin soothe.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask evenly on your face. Leave for 10–20 minutes, remove and massage the remaining essence into your skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing sheet mask with olive extract for dry, tired skin. It softens, nourishes and restores a healthy, radiant look. Especially good during colder months when skin suffers from wind and heating. Leave it on for 15–20 minutes and pat in the leftover essence — it works like a light nourishing serum.
tabs.Состав: Olive fruit extract nourishes and softens skin. Centella and chamomile soothe, while peony, gentian, yarrow and arnica extracts add botanical care.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, unfold the mask and place it on your face, smoothing it along the contours. Leave for 10–20 minutes, then remove and pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Характеристики: A honey sheet mask for dry, dull skin. It nourishes, hydrates and gives skin bounce and that signature “honey” glow. Great in colder months and after a long day. It’s a bestseller from Papa Recipe, a brand loved for its gentle honey-based formulas.
tabs.Состав: Honey, including manuka, and propolis nourish and soften skin. Licorice evens out tone, panthenol soothes, and ginger and grapefruit seed extracts round out the botanical care.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, place the mask on a dry face. Leave for 20–30 minutes, remove and pat the remaining essence into your skin.
After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face for about 10 minutes. Remove and pat your skin gently to spread the remaining essence.
tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating sheet mask with birch sap for dry, dehydrated skin. Mineral-rich birch sap gives fresh, light hydration, and hyaluronic acid helps lock it in. The thin sheet fits snugly, and afterwards skin looks soft and glowing.

A gel mask with Ulleungdo sea water for hydrated, refreshed skin. The sea-water minerals help nourish skin, and the gel base feels pleasantly cool. Great after sun or on hot days; leave on for 15–20 minutes and pat in the leftover essence.

A sheet mask from the Mugwort line for hydrating, soothing care. Cotton base; wear for 10–20 minutes. Mugwort is a traditional Korean ingredient for calming skin, helping relieve redness and irritation. Madecassoside supports recovery and caffeine refreshes. The mask suits sensitive and irritated skin.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients include mugwort extract, madecassoside, marshmallow extract and caffeine.
tabs.Применение: Place the mask on your face for 10–20 minutes. Remove and gently pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Состав: The Pine Cica Activer line combines pine extract with centella ingredients; the description also lists forms of hyaluronic acid and capryloyl salicylic acid (LHA).
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, leave the mask on for 10–20 minutes. Remove and pat your face so the remaining essence absorbs.
tabs.Характеристики: A calming sheet mask with pine and centella for sensitive, irritated skin. Pine extract refreshes, centella soothes redness, and hydrating ingredients help skin feel comfortable again fast. Great after sun, shaving or active treatments.

A mask for dry skin that craves softness and nourishment. The essence is rich and milky — your face stays smooth and well-cared-for afterwards. The three-layer sheet holds lots of essence and doesn’t slip while you relax. Free of parabens and dyes. Especially good in colder months when skin needs extra nourishment. Use the leftover essence on your neck and hands.
tabs.Состав: Avocado extract and macadamia oil nourish and soften skin, while apricot extract adds freshness. The essence has a whole vitamin complex: vitamins A, C and E, B vitamins and biotin. Panthenol, allantoin and dipotassium glycyrrhizate soothe.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face for 15–20 minutes. Remove and pat in the remaining essence. 1–2 times a week is enough.

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating cactus sheet mask for dehydrated skin. It refreshes, relieves tightness and soothes. The three-layer sheet holds lots of essence and doesn’t slip while you relax. Free of parabens and dyes. Especially nice in summer and after a flight when skin lacks moisture. Chill it in the fridge for an extra refreshing feel.
tabs.Состав: Prickly pear (cactus) extract hydrates and soothes and is rich in antioxidants. Hyaluronic acid helps skin hold on to moisture.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face for 15–20 minutes. Remove and pat in the remaining essence. 1–2 times a week is enough.

tabs.Характеристики: A pick-me-up mask for dull skin. The essence is light, almost watery — afterwards your face looks refreshed and your tone a little brighter. The three-layer sheet holds lots of essence and doesn’t slip while you relax. Free of parabens and dyes. Works great in the morning before makeup — skin looks fresh and rested. The light citrus scent is as energizing as coffee.
tabs.Состав: Lemon and acerola extracts are rich in vitamin C to brighten and add glow. Licorice evens out tone, panthenol and allantoin soothe, and glycerin hydrates.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face for 15–20 minutes. Remove and pat in the remaining essence. 1–2 times a week is enough.

tabs.Характеристики: A brightening pearl sheet mask for dull, tired skin. It evens out tone and gives skin a soft pearly glow. The three-layer sheet holds lots of essence and doesn’t slip while you relax. Free of parabens and dyes. Perfect before a night out or a big event — skin looks more radiant and even. Leave it on for 15–20 minutes and pat in the leftover essence.
tabs.Состав: Pearl extract brightens and adds radiance. The three-layer sheet is well soaked in essence and fits snugly to the skin.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face for 15–20 minutes. Remove and pat in the remaining essence. 1–2 times a week is enough.

tabs.Характеристики: A toning rose sheet mask for tired skin. It hydrates, refreshes and brings back a lively, rested look. The three-layer sheet holds lots of essence and doesn’t slip while you relax. Free of parabens and dyes. The rose scent turns it into a little ritual, and skin looks fresh and rested afterwards. Perfect for an evening after a long day.
tabs.Состав: Rose extract (1,000 ppm) tones and hydrates. The three-layer sheet is well soaked in essence and fits snugly to the skin.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, place the mask on your face for 15–20 minutes. Remove and pat in the remaining essence. 1–2 times a week is enough.

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating sheet mask from the DIVE-IN line with a multi-size hyaluronic acid complex. It quickly drenches dehydrated skin, relieves tightness and suits even sensitive types. The thin sheet fits snugly; leave it on for 15–20 minutes and pat in the leftover essence.

Heartleaf cleansing pads for gentle exfoliation and soothing. The textured side removes dead skin cells; the smooth side calms and preps skin for the next step. You can also use a pad as a mini mask on irritated areas. Gluconolactone (PHA) exfoliates very gently, so the pads suit even sensitive skin. Handy in the morning in place of toner.
tabs.Состав: 77% heartleaf extract soothes skin and calms redness. The PHA gluconolactone exfoliates very gently and suits even sensitive skin. Centella and its active compounds, betaine, green tea and purslane hydrate and soothe.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with the textured side, avoiding the eyes and lips. Then go over with the smooth side and pat in the remaining essence. Place a pad on irritated areas for a few minutes as a mask.

tabs.Характеристики: Eye patches with caviar and PDRN. They erase signs of fatigue, reduce puffiness and make the under-eye area smoother and fresher. The hydrogel clings and stays put, so you can wear them while getting ready. Great after a short night or before a big event.
tabs.Состав: PDRN supports skin recovery and firmness, while caviar water nourishes and adds glow. Caffeine reduces puffiness, niacinamide brightens dark circles, and adenosine smooths fine lines. Probiotic exosomes and allantoin hydrate and soothe.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, take a patch out with the included spatula and place it under your eye, pressing lightly. After 15–20 minutes, remove and pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Характеристики: BHA pads for blackheads and oily shine. They gently exfoliate, clear pores and even out skin texture. Suitable for oily and combination skin prone to breakouts. The pads come soaked in a jar and stay moist, so they’re easy to take along. Use them in the evening after cleansing, starting a few times a week. One of COSRX’s cult products.
tabs.Состав: Willow bark water — a natural source of salicylic acid — and betaine salicylate gently clear pores. Panthenol and allantoin soothe, and sodium hyaluronate hydrates. Tea tree oil helps fight inflammation.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with the textured side, avoiding the eyes and lips, then with the smooth side. Pat in the remaining essence and apply cream. Use SPF during the day.

drceuracle-teatree-pad.description: Tea tree pads for problem skin

tabs.Характеристики: Tea tree pads for problem skin. They calm inflammation, clear pores and help control oiliness without drying skin out. Handy for a quick routine morning and evening, they suit oily and combination skin. You can also leave one on inflamed spots for a few minutes.
tabs.Состав: Tea tree leaf water calms inflammation. Salicylic acid (BHA) clears pores, PHA gently exfoliates, zinc PCA regulates sebum production, and panthenol soothes.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with the textured side, avoiding the eyes. For intensive care, place pads on problem areas for 10–20 minutes, then remove and pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Характеристики: Bulgarian rose hydrogel patches for the eye area. They hydrate, refresh and erase signs of fatigue. You can also use them on other dry areas — the forehead or cheeks. The patches stay on well and don’t dry out in 20–30 minutes. The rose scent is light and pleasant, and concealer goes on more smoothly afterwards.
tabs.Состав: Bulgarian rose water and damask rose extract hydrate and tone. Niacinamide supports firmness and evens out tone, centella soothes, and sodium hyaluronate locks in moisture.
tabs.Применение: On clean skin, place two patches under your eyes or on areas that need care. After 20–30 minutes, remove and pat in the remaining serum with your fingertips. Then apply eye cream.

tabs.Характеристики: Exfoliating pads for enlarged pores and uneven texture. They remove dead skin cells and excess sebum, smooth skin and prep it for the next steps. Use them in the evening, starting 2–3 times a week, and wear SPF during the day. With regular use, pores look smaller.
tabs.Состав: 4.5% lactic acid (AHA) exfoliates the skin’s surface, while 0.45% salicylic acid (BHA) clears pores from within. Panthenol, allantoin and centella soothe skin after the acids.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with the textured side, avoiding the eyes and lips. Use the smooth side to remove residue and pat in the essence. Then serum and cream; always SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: Cooling agave hydrogel patches. They instantly refresh, reduce puffiness and hydrate the delicate eye area. Perfect for mornings after too little sleep. Keep them in the fridge for an even stronger cooling effect. They stay put without slipping, so you can wear them while getting ready in the morning.
tabs.Состав: A blue complex of agave, blueberry, eggplant, spirulina and caffeine cools and de-puffs. A seaweed complex hydrates, and green tea, heartleaf and mugwort extracts soothe.
tabs.Применение: Place a patch under each eye on clean, dry skin. After 15–20 minutes, remove and pat in the remaining essence. Use 2–3 times a week or as needed.

tabs.Характеристики: Hydrogel eye patches with shimmering particles. They refresh, reduce puffiness and signs of fatigue and bring back a bright look. 40 patches per jar — 20 treatments. The shimmering particles make the ritual beautiful, and the hydrogel clings snugly. Wear them for 20–30 minutes while getting ready in the morning.
tabs.Состав: Pearl and diamond powders give skin a soft glow. Niacinamide evens out tone and brightens dark circles, and adenosine smooths fine lines. Panthenol, allantoin, centella and chamomile soothe, and glycerin hydrates.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, take out two patches with the included spatula and place them under your eyes. After 10–20 minutes, remove and pat in the remaining essence. Use 3–4 times a week. In summer, keep the jar in the fridge and close the lid tightly so the patches don’t dry out.

tabs.Характеристики: Birch sap hydrating pads for dry and sensitive skin. Gentle enough for everyday use. Place them on dry areas as an express mask. Handy in the morning instead of toner — it saves time. The pads are soft enough for even very sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: Birch sap hydrates and refreshes. The Aquaxyl complex of xylitol and glucose helps skin retain moisture. Several types of hyaluronic acid, panthenol, allantoin and dipotassium glycyrrhizate soothe and soften skin.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with a pad. Place a pad on dry areas for 3–5 minutes, then pat in the remaining essence.

tabs.Характеристики: Hyaluronic acid hydrating pads for dehydrated skin. They gently smooth texture and instantly give skin moisture. Leave a pad on dry areas as a mini mask. The fragrance-free formula suits sensitive skin too. Use them in the morning instead of toner and in the evening as a hydrating mini mask on the cheeks.
tabs.Состав: Five types of hyaluronic acid of different sizes hydrate skin at different depths. PHA, citric acid and allantoin gently exfoliate. Panthenol, ceramide NP and betaine soothe and support the skin barrier. No fragrance or essential oils.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with a pad, then pat your skin so the essence absorbs. Place a pad on dry areas for 2–3 minutes. Suitable for morning and evening routines.

tabs.Характеристики: A light, watery toner for the step after cleansing. The formula, high in heartleaf extract, adds a hydrating and soothing step to your basic routine; the brand notes comfortable application and a fresh finish. Layer it thinly if your skin needs more hydration. Heartleaf is Anua’s star ingredient: it calms redness and helps irritation-prone skin. The toner is free of fragrance and alcohol, so it suits even very sensitive skin. It’s one of Korea’s most popular toners.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, pat the toner over your face with your palms. Apply one thin layer or repeat on areas that need more hydration. Then use serum and cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A leave-on BHA product for skin texture and areas prone to clogged pores. The formula is designed for gradual exfoliation and helps keep skin looking smoother. It’s an active product: choose how often to use it based on your skin’s sensitivity. It helps dissolve blackheads and makes pores look smaller. Apply in the evening on dry skin with a cotton pad or fingers, starting 2–3 times a week, and wear SPF during the day. One of COSRX’s cult products.
tabs.Состав: The main exfoliating ingredient is betaine salicylate (BHA); the formula also lists willow bark water, niacinamide, panthenol and sodium hyaluronate. COSRX’s official page states 4% betaine salicylate.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply a small amount with your palms or a cotton pad, avoiding the eye and lip area. Start with occasional use, don’t combine with other strong exfoliants and stop if persistent irritation occurs. Apply SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing cream for daily care when skin needs more hydration and barrier support. Spread it over your face as the final step. Suitable for morning or evening; adjust the amount depending on how dry your skin feels. Ceramides are the heart of the Ceramidin line, restoring the skin barrier and helping skin hold moisture. The cream is great for dry skin, cold seasons and after treatments. It’s loved for a rich yet comfortable texture.
tabs.Состав: The full ingredient list also includes emollients and cholesterol. Note that formulas and ingredient lists may change.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face after toner and serum and spread evenly. Pay extra attention to dry areas. Avoid broken skin and the eye area; stop if you react to it.

tabs.Характеристики: A citrus-themed serum for dull, uneven tone. Apply the light formula before cream; the brand positions it as part of a routine for post-acne marks and pigmented areas. Green tangerine extract from Jeju Island is rich in vitamin C and helps fade dark spots and post-acne marks. The serum is gentle enough for daily use, even on sensitive skin. With regular use, skin looks brighter; wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Применение: Apply a few drops to clean skin before cream. If your version contains an active form of vitamin C, start with occasional use and watch how your skin reacts. Add SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A vitamin C serum for dull tone and uneven texture. The brand describes it as a gentle formula with pure ascorbic acid; despite the moderate concentration, sensitive skin should introduce it gradually and patch-test first. The vitamin C concentration is gentle, making this a good first step into the ingredient. Fragrance-free. Over time skin looks more even and radiant.
tabs.Применение: Apply 3–4 drops to cleansed skin, avoiding the eyes, and spread gently. When starting out, use it every other day or less. If using in the morning, finish with sunscreen; store as directed on the bottle.

tabs.Характеристики: A final-step cream for skin with uneven tone and visible post-acne marks. The brand’s official Russian distributor describes it as a product with tranexamic acid and alpha-arbutin. It’s a cosmetic, not a medical treatment for pigmentation. Tranexamic acid and alpha-arbutin help fade dark spots and even out tone. The cream is suitable for daily use; always wear SPF during the day so pigmentation doesn’t come back.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean skin as the last step. Use sunscreen during the day, especially if your routine includes tone-evening products.
