tabs.Характеристики: An at-home mask that dries into a thin film on the skin, which you can then gently peel off. The formula gives a temporary feeling of hydration and a smoother-looking complexion. Collagen and lactobacilli help skin look firmer and smoother. Great before going out — skin looks fresh after just one use.
tabs.Состав: These ingredients are included for hydration and the look of skin texture.
tabs.Применение: Spread an even layer over clean, dry skin, avoiding the brows, hairline, eyes and lips. Wait until the clear film is completely dry and slowly peel it off from the edge, or rinse with warm water as directed for your version.

tabs.Характеристики: A vitamin cream for glow and an even tone. The texture contains yellow vitamin capsules that burst as you apply it, giving skin hydration and freshness. Suitable for daily use morning and evening. Pairs well with the No.5 serum and pads from the same line. With regular use, skin tone becomes more even and dark spots and post-acne marks less visible.
tabs.Состав: Kakadu plum extract — one of the richest sources of vitamin C — brightens and adds radiance. Niacinamide evens out tone, and bisabolol and panthenol soothe. Shea butter, phytosqualane and rosehip oil nourish and soften skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step, avoiding the eyes and lips, and gently pat into your skin. Use morning and evening; during the day, apply SPF after the cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A toner with an acid complex for skin texture and exfoliating dead surface cells. The formula includes soothing ingredients, but it’s still an active product, so build up frequency gradually. Tea tree helps with breakouts and centella calms skin. The toner suits oily and acne-prone skin, and the brand promises visible results after 30 days of regular use. Wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: The line combines AHA, BHA and PHA; the formula also features tea tree and centella.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply a thin layer with your palms or a cotton pad, avoiding the eyes and lips. Start with a few times a week; don’t combine it in one evening with other exfoliants or retinoids unless you’re experienced. If skin gets dry, use it less often, and wear SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A booster for your evening routine, applied as the first step after cleansing. The brand’s technology is based on Cica Reedle with silica microparticles; you may feel a tingling sensation. It isn’t an invasive procedure or a substitute for professional treatment. Silica micro-needles gently renew the skin surface and help skincare absorb better. “100” is the gentlest version in the line — a good starting point. Skin looks smoother and pores less visible.
tabs.Состав: VT’s official site lists Cica Reedle (silica and centella), centella, hyaluronic acid and propolis.
tabs.Применение: In the evening, apply an appropriate amount to clean, dry skin with your fingers without rubbing hard, then follow with moisturizer. Don’t apply to broken skin and don’t combine with Reedle Shot 300/700 at the same time. Don’t use together with LED or other beauty devices or right after treatments; follow the brand’s warnings.

tabs.Характеристики: An eye-area cream from the Bifida Biome series. Use a small amount, spreading it over the orbital area without pulling the skin. Bifida ferments strengthen the delicate skin around the eyes, and the nourishing texture helps smooth fine lines. Use it morning and evening — it sits well under concealer.
tabs.Состав: The Bifida Biome line is built around fermented ingredients, including bifida ferment.
tabs.Применение: Put a small drop on your ring finger and spread it gently along the orbital bone, staying away from the waterline. Use morning and/or evening after serum and before face cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for daily care of dull skin and uneven tone. The formula combines a hydrating base with ingredients the brand uses to support radiance and a more even complexion. Use it morning or evening after cleansing and before cream. The jelly texture melts nicely into skin. People love it for the soft glow and bounce right after applying.
tabs.Состав: Notable ingredients include niacinamide, arbutin, betaine, peptides and plant extracts. Niacinamide and arbutin are classic choices for dull tone, betaine helps keep skin hydrated, and peptides round out the formula for a smoother-looking complexion.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply a few drops to your face, spread and let absorb; then use cream. The brand recommends morning and evening use. If you use other concentrated actives, introduce one new product at a time to check tolerance. Finish with SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A retinol cream from the Reverse Activator line for fine lines, uneven tone and loss of firmness. Pure retinol targets wrinkles and uneven texture, while peptides support firmness. Use it in the evening, starting 2–3 times a week, and always wear SPF during the day. O HUI is LG’s premium Korean brand.
tabs.Состав: LG Beauty states 0.3% pure retinol within a 7.2% TruReverse Retinol+ Complex, plus peptides, rice oryzanol and soybean oil. The brand describes the encapsulated form as a way to stabilize retinol.
tabs.Применение: Apply a pea-sized amount in the evening to clean, dry skin, avoiding the lips and the area right around the eyes. The brand advises starting with two evenings a week, then gradually increasing if your skin tolerates it well. Don’t introduce several retinoid products at once. Use SPF in the morning; if you notice marked irritation, take a break and return to less frequent use.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream from the Real Eye Cream For Face line: apply it around the eyes or all over the face as the final hydrating step. Great if you want to combine care for the delicate eye area with spot care for dry patches. AHC is known in Korea as the eye cream brand, and this one is a top bestseller. The rich texture hydrates and helps smooth fine lines.
tabs.Применение: For daily care, after toner apply a small amount around your eyes and tap it in gently with your fingertips without pulling the skin. The brand also allows use on the whole face: spread the cream after your main routine and press it in gently with your palms until absorbed. Don’t apply too close to the waterline.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream for all skin types, including care for visible fine lines and less firm-looking skin. Sulwhasoo’s current international page calls it Concentrated Ginseng Rejuvenating Cream and offers 30 and 50 ml sizes. The brand describes the texture as nourishing yet easy to spread without warming it in your palms; there’s also a lighter version in the line. Sulwhasoo is one of Korea’s best-known luxury brands. The cream works best in the evening when skin needs rich care.
tabs.Состав: In the current line the brand highlights Ginsenomics — a concentrated ingredient from rare ginseng saponin — and Ginseng Peptide, complemented by several peptides, along with ingredients for hydration and comfort.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face as the final step after serum and other watery products. Spread from the center of your face outward and press gently with your palms until comfortably absorbed. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A light booster serum for dull, tired-looking skin. The brand links it to radiance, smoothness and a firmer-looking complexion; the formula combines an NAD+ complex with peptides and resveratrol. Hydrating ingredients make the texture more comfortable and keep skin feeling nourished. NAD+ is a trendy cell-energy ingredient that helps skin look more energized and fresh.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, spread a small amount over your face and neck and massage gently until absorbed. The brand suggests using it morning and evening; finish your morning routine with sunscreen. Introduce it gradually and watch how your skin reacts. Don’t apply to irritated or broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A retinal night cream for texture and the first visible signs of aging. The formula is topped up with softening and hydrating ingredients so that vitamin A care comes with comfort. Dr.Different is a Korean dermatology brand known for its retinal products. Start 2–3 times a week and always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: The key active is 0.1% retinal. The list also includes glycerin, squalane, safflower oil, shea butter, sodium hyaluronate, polyglutamic acid, ceramide NP and cholesterol for hydration and softness.
tabs.Применение: Use mainly in the evening on clean, dry skin: start with a small amount and occasional use, increasing frequency only if your skin tolerates it well. Don’t apply other retinoids or irritating actives to the same area at the same time. If skin gets dry, use it less often and add a simple moisturizer. Use sunscreen in the morning.

tabs.Состав: For the version on HERA’s international page, ingredients include Narcissus tazetta bulb extract, niacinamide, adenosine, squalane, shea butter and peptides including Acetyl Tetrapeptide-11 and Copper Tripeptide-1. This version contains fragrance and several fragrance allergens — worth noting for sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: For the 50 ml version, the brand recommends using the serum morning and evening after toner and emulsion. Spread a small amount from the center of your face outward.
tabs.Характеристики: A premium lifting serum for firmer skin and a more defined facial contour. Adenosine and niacinamide help smooth wrinkles and even out tone, while squalane softens and nourishes. HERA is Amorepacific’s luxury brand; apply morning and evening before cream.

A light eye serum with a metal roller. The roller feels pleasantly cool and helps spread the product without stretching the delicate skin. It targets firmness, hydration and smoother-looking fine lines. The 10 ml size is easy to carry around. Vegan collagen and peptides help skin look firmer, while hyaluronic acid hydrates without heaviness. It’s great in the morning — refreshing and smooth under concealer.
tabs.Состав: Vegan collagen, three types of hyaluronic acid and a five-peptide complex. Collagen and peptides support firmness; hyaluronic acid hydrates and smooths.
tabs.Применение: Morning and evening after toner, roll under your eyes and over the upper lid from the inner corner outward. Tap in any residue with your fingertips. Wipe the roller after use and replace the cap.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing cream for firmer skin. Ginseng and ceramides strengthen the skin barrier, while fermented retinol gently targets early signs of aging. The texture is creamy but not heavy — suitable for daily use, including for retinol beginners. Don’t forget SPF during the day. The cream pairs well with Beauty of Joseon serums and suits normal and dry skin.
tabs.Состав: Fermented retinol, ginseng ceramides and ginseng extract. Fermentation makes retinol gentler on the skin, while ceramides and ginseng nourish and support the barrier.
tabs.Применение: Apply to cleansed skin as the last step, evening or morning. Start by using it every other day so your skin can adjust. Always use sunscreen during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for firmer skin and smoother texture. A gentle concentration of retinol targets fine lines and enlarged pores, while peptides and panthenol make it more comfortable. A good first retinol. Apply in the evening, starting 2–3 times a week and increasing gradually. Always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: 0.1% retinol, a nine-peptide complex and 1% panthenol. Retinol renews the skin, peptides support firmness, and panthenol soothes and hydrates.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, apply 1–2 pumps to dry skin, avoiding the eye area. For the first two weeks use it every other night, then nightly. Follow with moisturizer; always use SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A light booster serum applied as the first step after cleansing. Six peptides support firmness and smoothness, while hyaluronic acid and amino acids hydrate. It helps the next products spread better and evens out skin tone. The booster suits every skin type, including sensitive, and pairs well with other actives. Peptides are a gentle way to start anti-aging care.
tabs.Состав: A six-peptide complex, hyaluronic acid, N-acetylglucosamine (NAG) and amino acids. Peptides support firmness, NAG an even tone, and hyaluronic acid and amino acids hydration.
tabs.Применение: Morning and evening after cleansing, apply 2–3 pumps to your face and press in with your palms. Then follow with toner, serum and cream as usual. Suitable for daily use.

tabs.Характеристики: A 0.5% retinol oil for skin that’s already used to retinoids. It targets wrinkles, loss of firmness and uneven texture. The oil base with vitamin E and squalane softens retinol’s effect and nourishes the skin. Apply a few drops in the evening on dry skin, starting 1–2 times a week. Always wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: 0.5% retinol, vitamin E and squalane. Retinol renews the skin, vitamin E protects it as an antioxidant, and squalane softens and locks in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Evenings only: 2–3 drops on dry, cleansed skin, avoiding the eye and lip area. Start with 2–3 times a week. If your skin is sensitive, mix it with cream. Always SPF during the day. Don’t use at the same time as acids.

tabs.Характеристики: A night ampoule that repairs your skin while you sleep. Fermented ingredients and probiotics support the skin barrier, and in the morning skin looks rested, firm and even. The light texture absorbs quickly. It’s often called an affordable alternative to luxury night serums. It suits every skin type and pairs well with other products.
tabs.Состав: The Extreme Biome complex of fermented ingredients and probiotics (77.2%), peptides and niacinamide. Ferments and probiotics repair the barrier, peptides support firmness, and niacinamide evens out tone.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and press in gently with your palms. Then apply cream. Suitable for daily use.

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for skin renewal and post-breakout marks. The light texture won’t weigh down your routine. Retinol renews skin and helps fade post-acne marks, while centella calms redness and softens retinol’s effect. A good pick if you’re just starting with retinol. Use it in the evening and wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Состав: Retinol, centella asiatica (cica) and soothing plant extracts. Retinol renews skin; centella calms redness and supports recovery.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, apply 1–2 pumps to dry skin. Start every other day, then nightly. Follow with moisturizer; SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A targeted corrector cream for visible wrinkles: on the forehead, between the brows, along nasolabial folds and around the eyes. Stabilized retinol works on wrinkle depth, and the applicator tip helps place the product exactly where needed. Apply in the evening, starting 2–3 times a week. IOPE is an Amorepacific brand known for its science-led anti-aging care.
tabs.Состав: 0.1% stabilized retinol plus caring and softening ingredients. Retinol renews skin and helps smooth wrinkles.
tabs.Применение: In the evening, apply a small amount to areas with wrinkles and spread gently. Start with 2–3 times a week, then use nightly. Always SPF during the day.

laneige-perfect-renew-serum.description: Anti-aging serum for firmness and glow

tabs.Состав: Retinol, peptides and vitamin C — each in its own chamber. Retinol smooths, peptides support firmness, and vitamin C adds radiance.
tabs.Применение: Morning and evening after toner, apply 1–2 pumps to your face and neck and spread with light strokes. Then apply cream. Always SPF during the day.
tabs.Характеристики: An anti-aging serum with three actives — retinol, peptides and vitamin C — kept in separate chambers and mixed only when you press the pump. That keeps them stable while they work together to smooth wrinkles, support firmness and add radiance. Apply in the evening before cream and wear SPF during the day.

A rich, nourishing cream for firm, smooth skin. Collagen helps retain moisture and smooths the look of fine lines. Great for evening care and for dry skin in the cold season. Mizon is known in Korea for its collagen products, and this cream is one of its bestsellers. It works well paired with a collagen serum or ampoule.
tabs.Состав: Collagen (about 54% of the formula) plus hydrating and nourishing ingredients. Collagen locks in moisture and makes skin smoother and firmer.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning or evening, spreading over your face and neck with upward strokes. For dry skin, apply a thicker layer in the evening as a sleeping mask.

tabs.Характеристики: Thin patches that gradually “melt” on the skin, releasing caring ingredients. Great for areas losing firmness and showing fine lines: under the eyes, along nasolabial folds, on the forehead. Visibly smoother, radiant skin by morning. They’re easy to wear overnight and almost fully dissolve by morning. Suitable for every skin type.
tabs.Состав: PDRN, collagen and hyaluronic acid. PDRN supports skin recovery, collagen firmness, and hyaluronic acid hydrates and smooths.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after your routine, apply the patches to dry skin on the areas you want to treat and leave overnight or for a few hours. Remove in the morning and wash your face. Use 2–3 times a week.

anua-pdrn-capsule-mist.description: PDRN and hyaluronic acid capsule mist

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating mist with capsules that burst as you spray. It refreshes and hydrates skin throughout the day, works over makeup and as a skincare step after cleansing. Leaves a light glow without stickiness. Keep it in your bag for the office, a flight or hot days. Suitable for every skin type, including dehydrated.
tabs.Состав: PDRN and encapsulated hyaluronic acid. PDRN supports skin recovery; hyaluronic acid hydrates instantly.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle to distribute the capsules and spray onto your face from 20–30 cm. Use after cleansing, before cream, or during the day whenever your skin needs hydration.

anua-pdrn-booster-toner.description: PDRN and hyaluronic acid booster toner

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating booster toner: it preps skin for the next steps and helps serums and creams spread better. Leaves skin soft, nourished and radiant. The light, watery texture suits all skin types. Layer it several times if your skin needs more moisture. Works well with the serum and cream from the PDRN line.
tabs.Состав: PDRN and several types of hyaluronic acid. PDRN supports recovery and firmness; hyaluronic acid hydrates different layers of the skin.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply the toner with your palms or a cotton pad and pat in lightly. For intense hydration, apply 2–3 layers. Then serum and cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle daily cleansing foam that cleanses without leaving skin tight. Great for your morning cleanse and as the second step of evening cleansing after an oil. The lather is thick and soft, and hyaluronic acid keeps skin from drying out. Suitable for every skin type, including sensitive.
tabs.Состав: PDRN, hyaluronic acid and gentle cleansing agents. Hyaluronic acid keeps skin hydrated while you cleanse.
tabs.Применение: Lather a small amount with water in your palms, massage over damp skin for 30–60 seconds and rinse with warm water. Use morning and evening, then follow with toner.

tabs.Характеристики: A PDRN serum in single-use 1 ml ampoules — a 10-treatment course. Easy to take on trips and use as an intensive recovery course. PDRN and hyaluronic acid help skin recover and look firm and glowing. One vial covers the whole face; use one every evening for 10 days or before a big event.
tabs.Состав: PDRN, hyaluronic acid and hydrating capsules. PDRN supports skin recovery and firmness; hyaluronic acid hydrates.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, open one ampoule and spread the serum over your face, tapping it in gently with your fingertips. Then apply cream. Use for 10 days in a row or every other day.

tabs.Характеристики: A milky toner for radiant, soft skin. The gentle texture hydrates and nourishes, leaving skin even and “lit from within”. Great for dry and normal skin, especially in the cold season. Rice is a traditional Korean ingredient for glowing skin. Apply with your hands or a cotton pad, or use it as your base before cream without serum.
tabs.Состав: Rice extract (70%) and ceramides. Rice evens out tone and adds radiance; ceramides support the skin barrier and lock in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle. After cleansing, apply the toner with your palms and pat it in. Then serum and cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich soothing cream for sensitive and irritated skin. It relieves discomfort and redness and repairs the skin barrier. A richer version of the classic Heartleaf 70 cream — great for dry skin and the cold season. The fragrance-free formula suits even very sensitive skin. Use it in the evening or as a rescue cream after sun and wind.
tabs.Состав: Heartleaf extract (70%) and ceramides. Heartleaf soothes and calms redness; ceramides repair the barrier and lock in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning and evening. Add a second layer on especially dry areas.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream that repairs the skin barrier. Ideal when skin is flaky, tight or irritated after active products. The soft texture nourishes without leaving a greasy film. Panthenol calms irritation and ceramides help skin hold moisture for longer. It suits dry and sensitive skin and works well in colder months.
tabs.Состав: Three types of ceramides and panthenol. Ceramides repair the barrier and lock in moisture; panthenol soothes and helps skin recover.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning and evening. Pairs well with retinol and acids — apply it after them to soften their effect.

tabs.Состав: Peach extract (77%) and niacinamide. Peach softens and hydrates; niacinamide evens out tone and adds radiance.
tabs.Применение: After toner and serum, spread a small amount over your face. For dry skin, top with cream. Use morning and evening.
tabs.Характеристики: A light milky emulsion with 77% peach extract and niacinamide for soft, glowing skin. Peach softens and hydrates, while niacinamide evens out tone and adds freshness. It absorbs quickly, so you can use it instead of cream in summer or as a hydrating step before cream in winter.

Pads for pore care and gentle exfoliation. They clear pores, smooth texture and soothe skin. Gentle PHA suits even sensitive skin. Use them in the evening after cleansing or in the morning instead of toner. Oily and combination skin can use them daily.
tabs.Состав: Heartleaf extract (77%) and PHA. Heartleaf soothes and calms redness; PHA gently exfoliates and clears pores.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with a pad along massage lines, focusing on areas with enlarged pores. Then toner or serum. Use once a day; every other day for sensitive skin.

anua-niacinamide-txa-pad.description: Niacinamide and tranexamic acid brightening pads

tabs.Характеристики: Brightening pads for an even tone: they target dark spots, post-acne marks and dullness. Use them daily as a toner or as a short mask on problem areas. Always wear SPF during the day. The pads pair well with the Niacinamide 10% + TXA 4% serum.
tabs.Состав: 5% niacinamide and tranexamic acid (TXA). Niacinamide evens out tone and strengthens the barrier; TXA helps fade pigmentation.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with a pad. Place a pad on dark spots for 5–10 minutes as a mask. Then serum and cream. Always SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream for targeting dark spots, post-acne marks and uneven tone. The light white texture absorbs quickly and suits daily use. Tranexamic acid and niacinamide help lighten spots, while licorice calms skin. Always wear SPF during the day so pigmentation doesn’t come back.
tabs.Состав: 3% tranexamic acid and 3% niacinamide brighten spots and even out tone; licorice root water soothes the skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply morning and evening as the last step, all over your face or directly onto spots. Always SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A mist with a creamy texture — the soothing 345 cream in spray form. It instantly hydrates and relieves tightness; refresh your face throughout the day, even over makeup. Keep it in your bag for the office or a flight. Suitable for sensitive and dehydrated skin.
tabs.Состав: Three types of hyaluronic acid, four rice-derived ingredients and five soothing ones — centella, aloe, panthenol and more.
tabs.Применение: Shake and spray onto your face from 20–30 cm after cleansing or during the day. Pat with your palms to help it absorb.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle, mildly acidic gel (pH 5–6) for daily cleansing. It cleanses, lightly renews skin and doesn’t leave it tight — suitable even for sensitive skin. Use it morning and evening, or as a second step after cleansing oil. Ceramides and hyaluronic acid keep skin from drying out.
tabs.Состав: Enzymes and mild acids for gentle renewal, betaine, ceramides and hyaluronic acid for hydration, and tea tree and centella for soothing.
tabs.Применение: Lather a little gel with water, massage over damp skin for 30–60 seconds and rinse. Use morning and evening.

dr-althea-147-barrier-cream.description: Barrier cream for dry skin, 15 ml

tabs.Характеристики: A cream for normal and dry skin that needs protection: after peels, retinol, in frost and wind. It repairs the barrier and keeps skin hydrated for a long time. Handy 15 ml mini size. Ectoin helps skin defend itself against cold and dry air. The mini size is handy for travel.
tabs.Состав: Ectoin, ceramides, betaine and betulin protect the barrier, and seven types of hyaluronic acid hydrate.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning and evening. Add a second layer on especially dry areas.

tabs.Характеристики: A light cleansing oil with a “watery” texture: it dissolves makeup, SPF and sebum in pores, rinses off easily and leaves no film. Gentle even on sensitive skin. Regular use helps reduce blackheads and makes pores look smaller. Suitable for oily and combination skin.
tabs.Состав: Light plant oils and mild emulsifiers that turn the oil into a milk on contact with water.
tabs.Применение: Apply 2–3 pumps to dry skin and massage, then add a little water until milky and rinse. Follow with a gel cleanser.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing balm that melts with the warmth of your hands and dissolves makeup, SPF and sebum. The jar has a built-in grinder that dispenses just the right amount — no dirty fingers in the jar. Rinses off easily without a greasy film. Centella calms skin, so the balm suits sensitive types too. It removes even long-wear makeup well.
tabs.Состав: Camellia seed and grapeseed oils dissolve impurities, while centella and its actives (madecassoside, asiaticoside) soothe the skin.
tabs.Применение: Twist the grinder lid to dispense a little balm. Spread over dry skin and massage, then add a little water — the balm will turn milky. Rinse and follow with a gel cleanser.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for glow and an even tone that suits even sensitive skin. Instead of harsh pure vitamin C, it uses sea buckthorn — a natural source of vitamin C — so skin looks fresh and rested without stinging. Use it in the morning under SPF and in the evening before cream. With regular use, skin tone becomes more even.
tabs.Состав: 63% sea buckthorn water — a vitamin C-rich extract that adds radiance and evens out tone.
tabs.Применение: Morning or evening after toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and tap in gently. Then cream. Always SPF during the day.

elizavecca-galactomyces-ample.description: Galactomyces ampoule for glow and an even tone, 50 ml

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule with a high concentration of galactomyces ferment filtrate — a fermented ingredient that makes skin more even and radiant. It helps refine pores, evens out tone and preps skin for the next steps. Galactomyces is the same fermented ingredient that made luxury essences famous, and here it’s especially concentrated. The ampoule suits dull skin with enlarged pores; use it morning and evening before cream.
tabs.Применение: After toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and tap in with your fingertips. Then cream. Morning and evening.

elizavecca-wine-peeling-pad.description: Wine extract peeling pads for pores

tabs.Характеристики: Pads for gentle exfoliation and pore cleansing: they remove dead skin, smooth texture and give skin a fresh look. Double-sided — the textured side for peeling, the smooth side for soothing. The pads are based on wine extract and mild acids that renew the skin surface and add radiance. Use them in the evening 2–3 times a week and wear SPF during the day.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with the textured side, then the smooth side. Use 2–3 times a week; SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle gel for daily cleansing of sensitive skin. It cleanses without drying or leaving skin tight. Handy pump. Erborian combines Korean technology with a French approach to skincare. The gel works for morning and evening cleansing.
tabs.Состав: Centella asiatica soothes and calms redness, and gentle cleansing agents carefully remove impurities.
tabs.Применение: Lather a little gel with water, massage over damp skin and rinse. Morning and evening.

erborian-centella-barrier-cream.description: Repairing centella and ceramide cream, 50 ml

tabs.Характеристики: A cream-balm for express repair of irritated, over-dried skin. It soothes, strengthens the skin barrier and relieves discomfort — great after active products and in the cold season. Centella soothes and calms redness, while the rich texture forms a protective layer on skin. Apply it all over or just on dry, irritated areas.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step all over your face or on irritated areas, morning and evening.

tabs.Характеристики: A jelly cream-pack you can leave on the skin after applying — no rinsing needed. The brand describes it as collagen care and registers it as functional cosmetics for visible wrinkles. Great as a richer final step when skin craves extra hydration and softness. It’s Elizavecca’s viral hit with the recognizable piggy packaging. Apply a thick layer overnight — in the morning skin looks bouncy and plump.
tabs.Применение: Scoop an appropriate amount with the spatula and apply to cleansed skin after toner. Massage lightly for about two minutes, then press gently with your palms until absorbed. No need to rinse. Don’t apply to broken or inflamed skin; if itching, swelling or persistent irritation occurs, stop using it and seek advice.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle body and hair wash for everyday use. The foam washes away impurities and is designed so skin doesn’t feel overly dry afterwards. Available in 500 and 1,000 ml bottles and refills. Ceramides help keep moisture in, so it suits dry and sensitive skin, including children’s. The mild, low-scent formula is handy for the whole family.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to wet skin or hair, lather with your hands or a sponge and rinse thoroughly. For hair, work the foam into your scalp and hair, then rinse well. If it gets in your eyes, rinse with water; if irritation appears, use it less often or stop.

tabs.Характеристики: A shower gel for daily body cleansing with a soft Baby Powder scent. The fragrance includes lavender and geranium accents with musky-woody notes. Comes in a bottle of about 910 ml. Panthenol softens skin and the lather is rich and gentle. The baby-powder scent is like fresh laundry and lingers on the skin for a while after your shower.
tabs.Состав: Contains the cleansing agents sodium laureth sulfate and cocamidopropyl betaine, sorbitol, panthenol, citric acid and fragrance. Sorbitol and panthenol add softening care to the cleansing base. Fragrance allergens are also listed, including citronellol and coumarin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to a wet washcloth or your palms, lather and spread over your body with gentle movements. Rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with the eyes. If your skin tends to be dry or reacts to scented products, start with a small amount and stop if you feel discomfort.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily body wash with a White Musk scent. The foam helps rinse away impurities and sweat, while aloe, honey and plant extracts add softening care. White Musk is described as a soft, clean musky scent. The typical bottle size is 500 ml; packaging and formula may be updated. Kundal is a Korean brand known for long-lasting, perfume-like scents — after your shower, skin keeps smelling of white musk for hours. The gel is gentle and doesn’t dry skin out.
tabs.Состав: The ingredient list includes cleansing agents, glycerin, aloe, honey and macadamia extracts, sodium hyaluronate, coconut, camellia and jojoba oils, and plant extracts. Fragrance creates the White Musk scent.
tabs.Применение: Apply a little gel to a wet sponge or your palms, lather and spread the foam over your body, focusing on areas that need cleansing. Rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. Rinse the sponge after use and let it dry. Avoid contact with the eyes and stop if irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: A body wash with an AHA, BHA and PHA acid complex for oily areas prone to blemishes. 400 g. It rinses off, but frequent use can dry the skin. The gel helps with breakouts on the back, chest and shoulders: acids gently exfoliate and clear pores, while tea tree calms inflammation. Leave the lather on for 1–2 minutes before rinsing, then follow with a moisturizing lotion.
tabs.Применение: Apply a little product to a wet sponge or your palms, lather and spread gently over your body, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Start with once a day or less, especially if your skin tends to be dry. If you notice tightness, flaking or irritation, use it less often or stop. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A body shower cleanser with exfoliating particles. It helps wash away impurities and makes skin feel smoother. Usually sold in a 400 ml size; some sets include a larger bottle or extra format. Unlike an intensive scrub in a jar, this is a rinse-off shower product. The soft beads don’t scratch, so you can use it 2–3 times a week. Ceramides help keep moisture in, so skin feels smooth rather than tight after your shower.
tabs.Применение: Apply to wet skin in the shower, lather and massage without pressing hard, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Don’t use on irritated or broken skin or right after shaving. With sensitive skin, start with occasional use and watch the reaction; don’t combine it on the same day with other intensive exfoliants on the same area.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off sugar scrub mask for gentle exfoliation and smoother-feeling skin. The formula contains oils that soften the skin during massage. On the body, use it on rough patches without pressing too hard. Black sugar gently dissolves as you massage, so the scrub won’t damage skin. It’s especially good for elbows, knees and other rough spots. After your shower skin feels smooth and soft even without lotion.
tabs.Состав: Sucrose forms the exfoliating texture. Glycerin, macadamia, meadowfoam, shea, evening primrose, olive and jojoba oils soften the skin. The list also includes rice ferment, fruit extracts and fragrance. Contains lanolin and fragrance components — keep this in mind when choosing.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to damp skin and massage the area very gently, avoiding broken skin. Then rinse thoroughly with warm water. No need to scrub hard; stop if it feels unpleasant. For the face, follow the brand’s separate instructions and avoid the eye and lip area.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich, concentrated cream for dry skin, made for areas that need more intensive softening. The formula leaves a protective, comfortable feel and suits spot care of very dry body areas. Ceramides restore the skin barrier and lock in moisture for a long time, so the cream works well in winter and for atopic skin. The whole family can use it, including children.
tabs.Состав: The formula is topped up with ginseng root water and plant extracts. This cream’s formula has been updated over time.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin and spread until comfortably covered. Use on dry body areas or as a final moisturizing step where a richer texture is needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing body lotion for dry and sensitive skin. The brand describes it as support for the skin barrier and long-lasting comfort: it helps relieve dryness and soften rough patches. The texture spreads easily over large areas for daily after-shower care. The international version is 400 ml. AESTURA is a Korean pharmacy brand that develops skincare with dermatologists. The lotion absorbs quickly with no stickiness, so you can get dressed right away.
tabs.Состав: The ingredient list includes the humectants glycerin and propanediol, squalane, panthenol, acetyl glucosamine, gluconolactone and ceramide NP — a softening base with ingredients for hydration and smoother-looking skin. The brand also highlights that the published international version is fragrance-free.
tabs.Применение: Apply the lotion after a shower while skin is still slightly damp, or to dry skin during the day. Spread over arms, legs and other areas that need extra hydration with gentle massaging movements until absorbed. Use more on especially dry spots. Avoid applying to broken or irritated skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing daily body lotion with a soft, warm, musky White Musk scent. The light creamy texture spreads easily and softens skin after a shower without feeling heavy. The brand’s bottle size is 500 ml. Perfect if you want basic hydration with a fragrance. Honey and macadamia oil nourish skin, while niacinamide helps it look more even and radiant. Pair it with the matching body wash for a longer-lasting scent.
tabs.Состав: The White Musk version lists aloe, glycerin, niacinamide, honey and macadamia extract, plus jojoba, meadowfoam and camellia oils, in a softening emulsion base with fragrance. These ingredients care for dry skin; the scented formula may not suit people sensitive to fragrance.
tabs.Применение: Spread the lotion over clean skin after a shower or whenever your skin feels dry. Apply to arms, legs and other areas with gentle strokes until absorbed. For a stronger scent, apply after bathing, but let your skin dry first. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily moisturizing lotion with a lighter texture than the series’ concentrated cream. Easy to apply over large areas of the body if your skin tends to be dry and needs regular softening. It spreads thinly and leaves skin comfortable. Ceramides help skin hold moisture, making it great for daily care of dry and sensitive skin. The mild, low-scent formula suits the whole family.
tabs.Состав: Also contains ginseng root water and plant extracts, including perilla. Formulas may be updated.
tabs.Применение: Apply after a shower to clean skin, especially dry areas of the arms and legs. Spread gently until absorbed; reapply where skin loses moisture quickly. Suitable for regular use. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: It softens dry skin and leaves it feeling cared for without a heavy, greasy finish. The scent pairs soft floral magnolia notes with warm sandalwood. Great for regular use, especially after an evening shower. 200 g. Aromatica is a Korean eco brand making skincare with natural oils and sustainable packaging. The cream is especially good in colder months.
tabs.Состав: Contains shea, evening primrose, meadowfoam, sweet almond, olive, sunflower and jojoba oils, plus glycerin, ectoin and ceramide NP. Magnolia, sandalwood, jasmine and geranium essential oils create the scent.
tabs.Применение: After a shower, pat your skin with a towel, leaving it slightly damp. Take an appropriate amount of cream and spread it over your body with massaging movements, then pat lightly to help it absorb. For richer care, focus on dry areas of the arms and legs.

tabs.Характеристики: A light body mist with a herbal citrus scent. It features basil and bergamot, with green woody notes of cypress and patchouli in the drydown. The watery texture refreshes skin quickly without leaving a heavy layer. 120 ml. Natural essential oils give a fresh, uplifting scent that’s lovely on a hot day. Aromatica is a Korean eco brand with sustainable packaging.
tabs.Состав: Contains alcohol and basil, bergamot, cypress and patchouli aromatic oils.
tabs.Применение: After a shower, spray onto clean, dry skin from about 20 cm, focusing on the areas you want, and let it dry. Don’t spray into the eyes, on mucous membranes or broken skin; if your skin is sensitive, start with a small area.

tabs.Характеристики: A perfumed body mist with the Ice Orange Blossom scent — a cool take on a citrus-floral bouquet. The main note is orange blossom, accented with bright citrus. The fine spray leaves a light layer of fragrance and is perfect for refreshing your scent during the day. Sold in a 150 ml size. Easy to carry and use instead of perfume — the scent is light and subtle. Spray it on your body and hair.
tabs.Применение: Spray onto your body from a comfortable distance after a shower or whenever you want to refresh the scent. Avoid the face, eyes, mucous membranes and irritated skin. Let it dry before it touches fabric.

tabs.Характеристики: A light perfumed body mist with a soft, sweet floral-fruity scent. It leaves a delicate fragrance and a light feeling of freshness. Great for refreshing your scent after a shower or during the day. Panthenol and hyaluronic acid lightly hydrate, so it doesn’t dry skin like regular perfume. Easy to keep in your bag.
tabs.Состав: Contains elderflower water, alcohol, betaine, panthenol, sodium hyaluronate and fragrance. The formula includes perfume components and potential fragrance allergens.
tabs.Применение: Spray onto clean, dry skin after a shower or onto chosen areas whenever you want to refresh the scent. Don’t spray into your face, eyes or mucous membranes. Let it dry before dressing; with sensitive skin, test on a small area first.

tabs.Характеристики: A scented body mist with a light spray that refreshes skin and leaves a soft White Musk trail. 128 ml. The scent is described as warm and clean musk; intensity and longevity depend on your skin and how much you apply. White Musk is Kundal’s most popular scent — clean and cozy, like fresh laundry. The mist pairs well with the matching body wash and lotion.
tabs.Состав: Also contains plant extracts and fragrance with fragrance allergens.
tabs.Применение: Spray onto your body from a short distance after a shower or during the day, avoiding the face, eyes and mucous membranes. Let it dry. You can also spray it on clothing — check first that it doesn’t mark the fabric. Don’t use on irritated or broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A two-phase body mist with a water and an oil phase that refreshes skin and helps keep it feeling soft. The brand links the formula to a fermented seaweed complex; shake to mix the layers for an even spray. Light texture with no heavy, sticky coating. Available in 160 ml bottles. Whamisa is a Korean organic brand that uses fermented plant ingredients in place of water. The mist is refreshing on hot days and after workouts.
tabs.Состав: The formula is rounded out with hydrating ingredients and plant oils that create the two-phase texture.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle well before use to combine the water and oil phases. Spray onto your body from a comfortable distance and spread gently with your palms. Don’t spray directly into your face, eyes or mucous membranes. With sensitive skin, start with a small area; don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A shampoo that cleanses hair and scalp with extra protein care for the lengths. The brand targets dry, damaged hair that you want to look smoother and more cared-for after washing. Features a complex of hydrolyzed proteins and keratin. Lador is a Korean professional haircare brand known for its protein treatments. The shampoo works well with the brand’s fillers and masks.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines cleansing agents with humectants and protein ingredients. The official description mentions betaine, hydrolyzed proteins and keratin; softening oils are also included.
tabs.Применение: Wet your hair and scalp, lather a small amount of shampoo with massaging movements, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. Try not to tangle the lengths while lathering — just spread the foam gently through your hair. After cleansing, use conditioner or a mask if your lengths need extra softening.

tabs.Характеристики: A shampoo for cleansing scalp and hair with the Angel Muguet scent. The brand describes this perfumed series as protein care for damaged lengths; this shampoo features a hydrolyzed protein complex. The lily of the valley scent is soft and fresh and stays on your hair after washing. Suitable for daily use and pairs well with the matching oil and treatment.
tabs.Состав: The formula’s key features are a cleansing base and a protein complex; the brand specifically mentions keratin and hydrolyzed proteins. The product is scented, and Angel Muguet is described as floral.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to thoroughly wet hair and scalp, lather with massaging movements, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. For dry or damaged lengths, follow with conditioner or a mask, applying them mainly to the lengths.

tabs.Характеристики: A cleansing shampoo for hair and a scalp troubled by dryness, itching or visible flakes. Piroctone olamine helps with dandruff, while lavender and rosemary extracts calm the scalp. It cleans gently without drying out the lengths. Fine for regular use, especially during heating season.
tabs.Состав: The official page lists a cleansing base, piroctone olamine and lavender, mint, chamomile and rosemary extracts, plus conditioning polymers and fragrance. These ingredients shape the shampoo’s properties but don’t mean it treats scalp conditions.
tabs.Применение: Apply an appropriate amount to a damp scalp and hair, massage gently into a lather, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Repeat if needed. Make sure no product is left on your hair and skin after the shower. For dry lengths, add conditioner through the lengths.

tabs.Характеристики: A cleansing shampoo for a scalp prone to sensitivity, itching or discomfort. The formula contains tea tree oil, and the brand also lists soothing plant extracts. Rinse it out completely after washing. The official page confirms a 330 ml size and highlights the product as specialized scalp care. Tea tree refreshes and helps control oil, so hair stays clean for longer. Great for oily scalps and summer.
tabs.Применение: Apply to thoroughly wet scalp and hair, lather with gentle massaging movements, then rinse completely. Don’t leave the shampoo on your skin or hair; the brand specifically warns to rinse thoroughly. If it gets in your eyes, rinse with water. If irritation persists, stop using it and consult a specialist.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off conditioner for dry, weakened hair, including after coloring or perming. The acidic pH helps seal the hair cuticle after coloring, so hair looks smoother and shinier and color lasts longer. Use it after every wash.

tabs.Применение: After shampooing, spread the conditioner through damp lengths, avoiding the eyes. For fine hair, use less product and apply mainly to the ends.

tabs.Характеристики: An intensive rinse-off treatment for dry, brittle and damaged hair. It softens the lengths, helps make them smoother and makes detangling easier. The Hydro LPP formula is built around protein care; the brand positions it for hair lacking elasticity and a well-kept look. Use it 1–2 times a week instead of conditioner: leave on for 5–10 minutes and rinse. Lador is a Korean professional haircare brand known for its protein masks.
tabs.Состав: Features hydrolyzed proteins, including keratin and silk, plus softening and hydrating ingredients. Proteins help the lengths feel denser and smoother, and the conditioning base reduces tangling. This is cosmetic care, not a permanent fix for hair structure.
tabs.Применение: After shampooing, squeeze out excess water and spread the treatment through the lengths, especially on dry or damaged areas. Leave for a few minutes like a regular conditioner, then rinse thoroughly. For more intensive care, leave it on longer within the brand’s instructions. Don’t apply to the face or eyes; for short or fine hair, start with less.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off hair treatment with the Osmanthus scent that softens the lengths and helps with detangling. The brand links its perfumed treatments to protein care for dry, damaged hair. Afterwards, hair is smoother and carries a signature osmanthus scent. Osmanthus is a flower with a warm apricot-and-honey scent, popular in Asian perfumery. Use the treatment 1–2 times a week instead of conditioner.
tabs.Состав: The brand lists hydrolyzed proteins and ceramides plus conditioning ingredients for the series. They help soften the hair surface and relieve dryness. Osmanthus is the scent, not an ingredient with claimed therapeutic effects.
tabs.Применение: After shampooing, spread an appropriate amount through damp lengths and ends, leave for about 3–5 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Avoid applying too close to the roots if your hair loses volume easily. Keep it out of your eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: A leave-in treatment in a fine-mist spray for dry, dull and damaged hair. The formula adds hydration and supports smoothness without rinsing. The official description highlights a complex of hydrolyzed proteins, including collagen, silk and keratin. The official version is 200 ml. Spray it on damp or dry hair before styling — it makes combing easier and protects the lengths. Hair becomes soft and shiny without being weighed down.
tabs.Состав: Contains hydrolyzed collagen, silk, keratin and elastin plus a keratin-based ferment. Glycerin, hemp, castor and camellia seed oils, sodium hyaluronate and ceramide NP soften the formula. The brand also lists plant extracts, including green tea and seaweed.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle well before use. Spray from about 10–20 cm onto the lengths and ends; the brand allows reapplying whenever hair feels dry.

tabs.Характеристики: A multi-purpose creamy hair treatment you can use as a quick rinse-off treatment or as a leave-in for the lengths. As a leave-in cream, apply a small amount to damp lengths and don’t rinse; start with a tiny amount so as not to weigh hair down.

Don’t apply too much at the roots if your hair loses volume easily. The official page lists it as a finishing product.

tabs.Характеристики: An oil for the lengths and ends with an osmanthus scent. It gives hair a smoother look and shine and softens dry areas. tabs.Состав: The oil has a softening base and the Osmanthus perfume composition; the brand also lists plant oils and hair-softening ingredients. It’s mainly a leave-in finishing product for the lengths.
tabs.Применение: Put a few drops in your palms, rub them together and spread through damp or dry hair, avoiding the roots. Start with the smallest amount, especially if your hair is fine or gets heavy easily. If needed, add more oil only to the ends.

Reapply every 2–3 hours in the sun.

anua-glow-sunstick.description: Invisible sunstick with a dewy finish

boj-relief-sun.description: Light rice and probiotic sunscreen, 50 ml

isntree-watery-sun-gel.description: Light hyaluronic acid sun gel, 50 ml

missha-vita-c-sunscreen.description: Vitamin C face and body sunscreen, 70 ml

Spread a generous amount over your face and neck as the last step before going out in the sun. Reapply when outdoors for long periods and after sweat, water or towel-drying.

Reapply every 2–3 hours if you’re in the sun for a long time.

Reapply every 2–3 hours if you’re in the sun for a long time.

A broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen with soothing, hydrating care. The retailer lists a 50 ml size. Niacinamide evens out tone and centella calms, so it suits sensitive skin. The light texture leaves no white cast and sits well under makeup. Reapply every 2–3 hours in the sun.
tabs.Состав: Retail descriptions of Skin Relief mention niacinamide, glycerin and centella.

tabs.Характеристики: The official site describes a fast-absorbing, hydrating finish with no stickiness or white cast. Available in 15, 50 and 100 ml and as a set. Centella calms and hyaluronic acid hydrates, so it’s great for sensitive and dehydrated skin. The light texture won’t pill under makeup.

Apply as the last step of your morning routine to exposed skin before sun exposure. Use enough product and reapply regularly.

Hydrating ingredients keep skin from drying out, and the finish stays fresh rather than greasy, so it sits nicely under makeup. Tocobo is a Korean brand with vegan formulas and sustainable packaging.

An everyday SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen with a light finish the brand describes as velvety and not too greasy. The Unscented version is 50 ml. Black rice is an antioxidant that helps protect skin, while niacinamide and ceramides support an even tone and a healthy barrier. The unscented version suits sensitive skin, and it sits nicely under makeup.

dasique-juicy-dewy-lip-tint.description: Juicy tint with a glossy finish

Dasique is known for its soft, Korean-style color palettes.

amuse-jel-fit-tint.description: Jelly tint with a wet shine

A jelly tint with a juicy shine and buildable color. Retail descriptions mention a formula with 42% hydrating essence, smooth glide and no heavy, sticky feel.
